en: 3  The Character of Calculability
zh: 第三章　可计算性的品格

en: In 1903 the German sociologist Georg Simmel published an essay describing modern life as a world of unrelenting calculation. People had developed, he wrote, “a purely matter-of-fact attitude in the treatment of persons and things.” He attributed the new mentality to the growth of large cities, which encouraged the development of an impersonal, individualized rationality at the expense of the more deeply felt emotional ties of life in the countryside and small towns. A calculating mentality was connected with the concentration of commercial transactions in the large city, or what he called “money economy”: “The metropolis has always been the seat of money economy,” Simmel argued, “because the many-sidedness and concentration of commercial activity have given the medium of exchange an importance which it could not have acquired in the commercial aspects of rural life.”
If money economy had made the modern mind “more and more a calculating one,” this could be connected with the way modern science was transforming the world into questions of mathematics:
zh: 1903年，德国社会学家格奥尔格·齐美尔发表了一篇文章，把现代生活描述为一个无情计算的世界。他写道，人们已经发展出“在对待人和物时一种纯粹就事论事的态度”。他把这种新心态归因于大城市的成长；大城市鼓励一种非人格化的、个体化的理性，其代价是乡村和小镇生活中更深刻的情感纽带。计算心态与商业交易在大城市的集中有关，或者与他所谓的“货币经济”有关：“大都市一直是货币经济的所在地，”齐美尔论证说，“因为商业活动的多面性和集中性，赋予交换媒介一种它在乡村生活的商业层面不可能获得的重要性。”
如果货币经济已使现代心智“越来越成为一种计算的心智”，那么这可以与现代科学把世界转化为数学问题的方式联系起来：

en: The calculating exactness of practical life which has resulted from a money economy corresponds to the ideal of natural science, namely that of transforming the world into an arithmetical problem and of fixing every one of its parts in a mathematical formula. It has been money economy which has thus filled the daily life of so many people with weighing, calculating, enumerating, and the reduction of qualitative values to quantitative terms.
zh: 由货币经济产生的实际生活的计算精确性，符合自然科学的理想，即把世界转化为一个算术问题，并把其每一部分固定在一个数学公式中。正是货币经济，使如此多人的日常生活充满了称量、计算、计数，以及把质的价值还原为量的术语。

en: The new “character of calculability” had introduced a precision and unambiguousness in social relationships, Simmel concluded, “just as externally this precision has been brought about through the general diffusion of pocket watches.”
zh: 齐美尔总结说，新的“可计算性的品格”在社会关系中引入了精确性和明确性，“正如从外表上说，这种精确性是通过怀表的普遍普及而实现的”。

en: “The Metropolis and Mental Life,” as the essay was called in English, became one of the most widely read works of twentieth-century social theory. At the University of Chicago, built with John D. Rockefeller’s money into a powerhouse of the new professional fields of social science, the essay was translated into English by Edward Shils and incorporated in 1936 into the syllabus of a new, unified social science curriculum, to be read by every undergraduate. Yet just fourteen years later, in 1950, another translation appeared, which changed the terms of Simmel’s argument about money economy and the growth calculability.
The alteration followed a change in the meaning of the English word “economy” that had occurred in the same fourteen years.
zh: 这篇文章在英语中题为《大都市与精神生活》，成为20世纪社会理论中读者最广的著作之一。在芝加哥大学——约翰·D. 洛克菲勒的资金把它建成社会科学新专业领域的重镇——爱德华·希尔斯把文章译成英文，并于1936年收入一门新的统一社会科学课程的大纲，供每一位本科生阅读。然而仅仅十四年后，即1950年，另一个译本出现了，它改变了西美尔关于货币经济与计算性成长的论证的措辞。
这一改动所跟随的，是英语中“economy”一词的含义在这同样的十四年间发生的变化。

en: In the 1930s the word “economy” (and Wirtschaft in German) meant something like “the principle of seeking to attain, or the method of attaining, a desired end, with the least possible expenditure of means,” to quote the 1925 edition of Palgrave’s Dictionary of Political Economy.
By extension, “money economy” referred to the attitudes and transactions of commercial exchange, a way of “dealing with men and things,” in Simmel’s phrase.

By 1950 the word had acquired a new meaning. It no longer referred to a set of attitudes and relations but denoted a distinct social sphere, “the economy” (now always with a definite article), the realm of a social science, statistical enumeration, and government policy.
zh: 在20世纪30年代，“economy”（德语为Wirtschaft）一词的含义近似于“以尽可能少的手段支出追求达到、或采用某种方法达到某一期望目的的原则”，这是1925年版帕尔格雷夫《政治经济学辞典》的说法。
引申而言，“货币经济”指商业交换的态度和交易，用西美尔的话说，是一种“对待人和物的方式”。
到1950年，这个词已经获得了新的含义。它不再指一组态度和关系，而指一个独特的社会领域，“the economy”（此时总带定冠词），即社会科学、统计列举和政府政策的领域。

en: This change was reflected in the changed wording of the 1950 translation of Simmel’s essay. The definite article was inserted into both passages quoted above: “The metropolis has always been the seat of the money economy,” wrote Gerth and Mills, the authors of the second translation, adding the innocent word I have italicized. “The calculative exactness of practical life which the money economy has brought about corresponds to the ideal of natural science.”

The modification made it seem as though Simmel were referring to this newly realized object, the economy. Simmel was not the only German social theorist to suffer this revision in American hands. Talcott Parsons did the same thing in the same period to Simmel’s more famous contemporary, Max Weber.
zh: 这一变化反映在西美尔文章1950年译本改动后的措辞中。上面引用的两段都被插入了定冠词。“大都市一直是货币经济（the money economy）的所在地，”第二译本作者格斯和米尔斯写道，加上了这个我用斜体标出的看似无害的词。“实际生活由货币经济（the money economy）带来的计算精确性，符合自然科学的理想。”
这一改动使西美尔看起来像是在指称这个新近实现的对象——经济。西美尔不是唯一在美国人手中遭受这种改写的德国社会理论家。塔尔科特·帕森斯在同一时期对西美尔更著名的同时代人马克斯·韦伯做了同样的事。

en: The definite article that slipped gently into the world between the 1930s and the 1950s was a marker of one of the most profound intellectual and political changes of the twentieth century. Its importance is only confirmed by the fact that no one has noticed it took place. Polanyi, Tribe, Dumont, Foucault, Buck-Morss, and others have argued that the economy became a distinct sphere of social practice and intellectual knowledge in the eighteenth or early nineteenth century.

Yet the political economists of that period do not describe a distinct structure called “the economy” or use the term in its mid-twentieth-century sense. They use the word only with the meaning defined by Palgrave, above, or in an older sense referring to the “proper governing” of the community’s affairs. The term “political economy” refers to this economy, or governing, of the polity, not to the politics of an economy. Even Friedrich List, the nineteenth-century German– American political economist and entrepreneur who is sometimes singled out and said to be writing precociously about “national economy,” was writing in this sense.
zh: 这个在20世纪30年代至50年代间悄然潜入世界的定冠词，是20世纪最深刻的思想与政治变化之一的标志。它之所以重要，恰恰因为没有人注意到它的发生。波兰尼、特赖布、杜蒙、福柯、巴克-莫斯等人论证说，经济在18世纪或19世纪初成为社会实践和知识的一个独特领域。
然而，那个时期的政治经济学家并没有描述一个叫作“经济”的独特结构，也没有在20世纪中叶的意义上使用这个词。他们使用该词时只带帕尔格雷夫所定义的上述含义，或带有指共同体事务“妥善治理”的较早含义。“政治经济学”指政治体的这种经济或治理，而不是某个经济的政治。甚至19世纪德裔美国政治经济学家、企业家弗里德里希·李斯特——有时被人单独挑出，说他已经早熟地谈论“国民经济”——也是在这种意义上写作的。

en: Only toward the end of the 1930s was the new idea of “the economy” realized, and as late as the 1950s writers still sometimes felt the need to explain what the word now meant.

It came to refer to a self-contained structure or mechanism whose internal parts are imagined to move in a dynamic and regular interaction, separate from the irregular interaction of the mechanism as a whole with what could now be called its exterior. A variety of other spaces could now be conceived in terms of their relationship to this hermetic field: the sphere of politics or the state; the sphere of law (previously at the center of questions of political economy); the sphere of science and technology; and the sphere of culture.

Among these objects, the economy was distinguished by the fact that it stood for the material sphere of life. At the same time, as the sphere of rational and numerical calculation, it was the one most easily represented in statistical and algebraic forms. For this reason, the most abstract and mathematical of the social sciences, economics, claimed the task of representing what seemed the most real aspect of the social world.
zh: 直到20世纪30年代末，“经济”的新观念才得以实现；而迟至50年代，作家们有时仍觉得需要解释这个词此时的含义。
它开始指一个自足的结构或机制，其内部各部分的运动被想象为一种动态而规则的相互作用，与整个机制同此时可称为其“外部”的不规则相互作用相分离。其他各种空间现在都可以参照它们与这一密闭领域的关系而被设想：政治或国家的领域；法律的领域（此前处于政治经济学问题的中心）；科学与技术的领域；以及文化的领域。
在这些对象中，经济的独特之处在于它代表生活的物质领域。同时，作为理性和数值计算的领域，它又是最容易以统计和代数形式来表征的。因此，社会科学中最抽象、最数学化的经济学，承担了表征社会世界看似最真实方面的任务。

en: In the Introduction I criticized culturalist or constructivist approaches to social understanding for leaving ultimately undisturbed the distinction routinely made between the constructed and the real, the cultural and the material, the social and the economic. So my argument here is not going to be that the economy was a “cultural construction” of the twentieth century, that it was something imagined or invented. Rather, I would like to suggest that in the twentieth century the economy was made. The economy was an artifact and, like all things artifactual, was made out of processes that were as much “material” as they were “cultural,” and that were as “real” as they were “abstract.” Indeed, these distinctions cannot provide a basis for making sense of how the economy appeared, for the apparent bifurcation of the world into the real and the abstract, the material and the cultural, does not precede the making of the economy. On the contrary, the economy was a set of practices for producing this bifurcation. It was both a method of staging the world as though it were divided in this way into two, and a means of overlooking the staging, and taking the division for granted.
zh: 在导论中，我批评了文化主义或建构主义的社会理解路径，因为它们最终没有触动人们惯常作出的区分：建构之物与真实之物、文化与物质、社会与经济。所以我这里的论点不会是经济是20世纪的“文化建构”，是某种被想象或发明的东西。相反，我想提出，经济在20世纪是被制造出来的。经济是一件人工制品；如同一切人工制品，它由一些既同样“物质”又同样“文化”、既同样“真实”又同样“抽象”的过程制造而成。事实上，这些区分无法为理解经济如何出现提供基础，因为世界划分为真实与抽象、物质与文化的表面二分，并不先于经济的制造。相反，经济是一套生产这种二分化的实践。它既是一种把世界展演为仿佛如此一分为二的方法，也是一种忽视这种展演、把划分视为理所当然的手段。

en: To uncover the genealogy of the economy, this chapter looks at the earlier decades of the twentieth century, and puts aside the fact that we know (or think we know) what an economy is. How did those attempting to manage the political and economic problems of their times make sense of things? This approach differs from the normal procedure, in which one assumes that those dealing with finance, trade, agriculture, landownership, manufacturing, population, urban growth, and related topics were dealing with “the economy”— even if they did not give it this name and often dealt with things that today might not be considered part of the economy. Such an approach attributes to earlier periods a way of dealing with the world that they did not have, in terms of an object—the economy—that had not yet been made. It gives us no way of telling what difference was made by one of the most powerful new objects of the twentieth century. The realization of the economy made possible new practices (of development, management, and government, to name a few), new claims to expertise, new equivalences, and new silences, not one of which is easy to uncover when we project the economy onto periods whose politics were not organized around this object. On the other hand, by examining what it means to be living in a period when no one knows what will constitute the economy, or even that such an object might materialize, perhaps we can get a better sense of what its materialization involved.
zh: 为了揭示经济的谱系，本章考察20世纪较早的几十年，并把我们自认（或自以为）知道经济是什么这一事实搁置一旁。那些试图处理当时政治和经济问题的人，是如何理解事物的？这一路径不同于通常程序：通常假定那些处理金融、贸易、农业、土地所有权、制造业、人口、城市增长及相关主题的人，就是在处理“经济”——即使他们没有给它这个名字，而且常常处理今天可能不被视为经济之一部分的事情。这种路径把一种他们并不具有的对待世界的方式归于较早时期，依据的是一个尚未被制造的对象——经济。它使我们无法判断20世纪最强大的新对象之一造成了什么差异。经济的实现使新的实践（例如发展、管理和治理）、新的专门知识主张、新的等价关系和新的沉默成为可能，而当我们把经济投射到其政治并非围绕这一对象组织的时期时，这些没有一项是容易揭示的。另一方面，通过考察生活在一个无人知道什么将构成经济、甚至无人知道这样一个对象可能成形的时期意味着什么，我们也许能更好地感受它的物质化涉及什么。

en: The chapter explores these questions in early twentieth-century Egypt. Examining what happened in Egypt will enable us to introduce the issue of colonialism into the history of economics. It is important to appreciate to what extent the realization of the economy belongs to the history of colonialism. The economy appeared in the context of the collapse of an imperial order. World-encircling arrangements of investment, management, production, information, and trade based on the political control of colonial resources gave way to arrangements based on ostensibly national economies. The economy was constructed by definition and default as a national rather than imperial space.

The nation, and the national economy in particular, provided the format of what could appear as a postimperial political topography. John Maynard Keynes, a critical figure in the making of the economy, published his first book, Indian Currency and Finance (1913), while employed at the India Office in London.

The book addressed a set of questions whose larger answer was later to be formulated as the national economy: how to conceptualize, measure, and manage the circulation of money within a defined geographical space. Indeed, it was in relation to the problems of colonial rule that several of the problems of managing the enclosed spaces of the economy were originally worked through. Moreover, as an apparatus to be managed and made more efficient, the economy was the object upon which the new politics of development was built after the 1930s. The development of economies provided the forms and formulas through which European colonial powers could attempt to restructure the relationship with their colonies in the mid-twentieth century, and through which imperial powers whose reach was still expanding, in particular the United States, could find a new mode of operation.
zh: 本章在20世纪初的埃及探讨这些问题。考察埃及发生的事情，将使我们能把殖民主义问题引入经济学史。重要的是认识到，经济的实现在多大程度上属于殖民主义的历史。经济出现在一个帝国秩序崩溃的语境中。以对殖民地资源的政治控制为基础的、环绕全球的投资、管理、生产、信息和贸易安排，让位于以表面上民族经济为基础的安排。经济按定义和默认被建构为民族的而非帝国的空间。
民族、尤其是民族经济，提供了可以被视为后帝国政治地形的那种格式。约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯是经济制造的关键人物，他在伦敦印度事务部任职期间出版了他的第一本书《印度货币与金融》（1913）。

这本书讨论了一组问题，其更大的答案后来被表述为国民经济：如何概念化、衡量和管理货币在特定地理空间内的流通。事实上，正是在与殖民统治问题的关系中，管理经济这个封闭空间的若干问题最初得到了细致的探讨。此外，作为一套有待管理并提高效率的装置，经济成为20世纪30年代后新发展的政治所依托的对象。经济的发展提供了各种形式和公式，欧洲殖民列强借助它们试图在20世纪中叶重组与殖民地的关系，而那些势力仍在扩张的帝国，尤其是美国，也借助它们找到了一种新的运作方式。

en: the great map
zh: 大地图

en: In 1909 a group of bankers, businessmen, government officials, and scholars established in Cairo the Société Khédiviale d’Economie Politique de Statistique et de Legislation. The society met in a mansion near the Nile that housed the new national university, founded a few months earlier.

It drew its members from Cairo’s cosmopolitan elite, both native Cairenes and members of the large community of expatriate Europeans. In January 1910 the society launched what became an influential journal of political economy, L’Egypte Contemporaine, publishing articles in English, French, and Arabic. The aim of the society was to organize and support research, congresses, and journeys of study, exploring “the problems of national life.” Its rules forbade any discussion of a purely political or religious nature.
zh: 1909年，一群银行家、商人、政府官员和学者在开罗建立了总督府政治经济学、统计学与立法学会。学会在尼罗河畔一座宅邸中聚会，几个月前新成立的国立大学也设在那里。
其成员来自开罗的国际化精英，既有本地开罗人，也有庞大的欧洲侨民群体。1910年1月，学会创办了一份后来颇具影响力的政治经济学杂志《当代埃及》（L’Egypte Contemporaine），以英文、法文和阿拉伯文发表文章。学会的宗旨是组织和支持研究、会议和考察旅行，探讨“国民生活的各种问题”。其章程禁止任何纯政治性或宗教性的讨论。

en: Rather than leaving this intellectual activity to the initiative of individual members, most of who were involved in business or government, the founders of the association launched a collective research project to which all members might contribute. Searching for the broadest possible topic, they proposed an investigation of landed property (propriété foncière) in Egypt, describing this as the country’s “great problem.”

They published an outline of the research program in the journal. The outline makes clear that with this topic they intended to encompass something far broader than the question of landownership: Part I, La Nature et L’Homme, would cover geography and climate, population (the 1907 census, immigration and emigration, the legal status of natives and Europeans), and the distribution of property. Part II, La Mise en Valeur du Sol, would examine different owner-producer relations, agricultural methods, capital, and forms of production. Part III would deal with the marketing of agricultural products, including the relation between the market, prices, and the land’s value. And Part IV would examine the social and economic condition of the producers. For the founders of the society, the existence of landed property provided a way of organizing and picturing a great diversity of social phenomena and economic relations. It portrayed these diverse relations as established within a common physical space, the space defined by the agrarian property relations examined in the previous chapter.
zh: 学会创始人没有把这项智力活动留给大多从事商业或政府的个人成员自行发起，而是发起了一个所有成员都可参与的集体研究项目。为了寻找尽可能宽泛的题目，他们提议调查埃及的土地产权（propriété foncière），把这一问题描述为国家的“大问题”。

他们在杂志上发表了研究大纲。大纲清楚表明，他们打算以此题目涵盖远比土地所有权更广泛的内容：第一部分“自然与人”（La Nature et L’Homme）将涵盖地理与气候、人口（1907年普查、移民与侨居、本地人与欧洲人的法律地位）以及财产分配。第二部分“土地的开垦”（La Mise en Valeur du Sol）将考察不同的业主—生产者关系、农业方法、资本和生产形式。第三部分将讨论农产品的销售，包括市场、价格与土地价值之间的关系。第四部分将考察生产者的社会和经济状况。对于学会创始人来说，土地产权的存在提供了一种组织和描绘极其多样的社会现象与经济关系的方式。它把这些多样关系描绘为建立在一个共同的物理空间之内，而这个空间正是上一章所考察的农业产权关系所界定的。

en: The idea that a country’s social and economic relations can be pictured in terms of agrarian property draws on the nineteenth-century tradition of Anglo-Scottish and French political economy, the tradition of Quesnay, Smith, and Say, but especially of David Ricardo. For Ricardo, the dynamic of creating wealth began not with the act of exchange, but with the process of settling and cultivating an empty land, a space of colonization. The power to colonize the land gave rise to private property, and thus to rent, or the income that flows from exclusive control of the land. As colonization spread and inferior land was brought under ownership and cultivation, the difference in rent between land of different quality opened up the possibility of an increasing profit, and thus the general expansion of wealth.
The entire question of wealth was framed by the space of colonization and the possibility of landed property.
zh: 一国的社会与经济关系可以从农业产权角度来描绘，这一观念借鉴了19世纪盎格鲁-苏格兰和法国政治经济学的传统，即魁奈、斯密和萨伊，尤其是大卫·李嘉图的传统。对李嘉图而言，创造财富的动力并非始于交换行为，而始于开垦和耕种一片空地的过程，一个殖民的空间。殖民土地的力量产生了私有产权，从而产生地租，即从对土地的排他性控制中流出的收入。随着殖民扩展、较劣等的土地被纳入所有权和耕种，不同质量土地之间的地租差异开辟了利润增长的可能性，从而带来财富的普遍扩张。
整个财富问题都由殖民空间和土地产权的可能性来框定。

en: Ricardo’s work was transformed by John Stuart Mill, and again by Marx, to take account of the production of wealth in manufacturing, and the novel forms of spatial organization, discipline, and power out of which the modern factory was built. Then, from the 1870s, a new, academic economics abandoned this entire tradition, putting in its place a locationless notion of “exchange.” The space of the act of exchange was formulated geometrically, by the axes of a chart, as the two-dimensional plane in which the desires, or utilities, of a buyer and a seller intersected. This planar space carried no reference to the countryside, the city, the factory, or any other conception of place.
zh: 李嘉图的著作先由约翰·斯图尔特·密尔、又由马克思加以改造，以考虑制造业中财富的生产，以及现代工厂得以建立的新型空间组织、纪律和权力。然后，从19世纪70年代起，一门新的学院经济学抛弃了整个这一传统，代之以一种无位置的“交换”观念。交换行为的空间被几何地表述为图表的坐标轴，即买方和卖方的欲望或效用相交的二维平面。这个平面空间不涉及乡村、城市、工厂或任何其他地方概念。

en: The older tradition of political economy was not abandoned, however, but was developed in Europe outside the field of economics, especially in faculties of law. It was French and Italian professors of law who helped develop the field of political economy in Cairo. The salience of the older tradition in Cairo reflected the situation there at the turn of the twentieth century. The system of private estates, examined in the previous chapter, was now established. The new space of landed property—a protonational space, but not the space of a national economy—provided the means to address and seek to solve “the problems of national life.”
zh: 然而，较早的政治经济学传统并未被抛弃，而是在欧洲经济学领域之外、尤其是在法学院中得到发展。帮助在开罗发展政治经济学领域的，正是法国和意大利的法学教授。这一较早传统在开罗的突出地位，反映了20世纪之交当地的情势。上一章所考察的私人地产制度此时已经确立。新的土地产权空间——一个前民族的空间，但不是民族经济的空间——提供了处理和设法解决“国民生活问题”的手段。

en: In 1907, on the eve of the founding of the Société d’Economie Politique, the Ministry of Finance completed a project that helped format and make knowable this new spatial order: a countrywide survey of the cultivation and ownership of land.

Apart from the reporting of deaths and contagious disease, the survey was the first large statistical operation the British undertook in Egypt. An older Bureau Central de Statistique, set up in 1870 and revived after a period of inactivity in 1878, had been closed down by the British. The bureau had carried out a census in May 1882 on the eve of the colonial occupation, and its closing as part of a reduction in government expenses in March 1883 impeded the processing and publication of the census returns.

Although another census was taken in 1897, and statistics on foreign trade were compiled at the port of Alexandria, there was no continuous and systematic government production of statistical knowledge until the launching of the land survey. The survey therefore played a central part in making a space of national calculation available.
zh: 1907年，就在政治经济学学会成立前夕，财政部完成了一个有助于格式化并使这一新空间秩序可被认识的项目：一次全国范围的耕地与土地所有权调查。
除了死亡和传染病报告之外，这次调查是英国人在埃及开展的第一次大型统计行动。一个较早的中央统计局设于1870年，在1878年一段停滞后恢复，后被英国人关闭。该局曾在殖民占领前夕的1882年5月进行人口普查；它于1883年3月作为政府开支削减的一部分被关闭，妨碍了普查材料的处理和出版。
尽管1897年又进行了一次普查，外贸统计也在亚历山大港编制，但直到土地调查开展之前，政府没有持续、系统的统计知识生产。因此，这次调查在使一个全国计算的空间变得可用方面发挥了核心作用。

en: Begun in 1898, the survey was based upon a novel technique of figuring the relationship between people and land embodied in the law of property: the large-scale map. In the surveyors’ decade of work they produced twenty thousand separate maps depicting the country’s entire agricultural area, field by field and plot by plot, at a scale of 1:2,500 (one centimeter representing twenty-five meters, or about twenty-five inches to one mile). For every plot, the smallest of which were just a few millimeters square on the map, the name of the owner was listed, and these names were compiled into registers of landowners and their tax liabilities.
By 1908, a year after the completion of the survey, the government had distributed some 100,000 of these map sheets, issuing 82,008 to government departments and selling 17,685 to the public.

In less than a decade the countryside had been transformed from a place in which maps played no role in administrative practice, legal argument, or financial calculation, to one of the most closely mapped terrains in the world.
zh: 调查始于1898年，依据的是一种体现产权法所规定的人地关系的新技术：大比例尺地图。在整整十年的工作中，测量员制作了两万幅单独地图，逐田逐块地描绘该国全部农业区域，比例尺为1:2,500（一厘米代表二十五米，约合每英里二十五英寸）。每一块地——其中最小的在地图上只有几毫米见方——都列有所有者姓名，这些姓名被编入土地所有者及其纳税义务的登记册。
到1908年，即调查完成一年后，政府已分发了约十万幅地图，其中82,008幅发给政府部门，17,685幅售予公众。
在不到十年间，乡村从一个地图在行政实践、法律论辩或财务计算中毫无作用的地方，转变为世界上测绘得最细致的地域之一。

en: The making of these maps introduced new forms of measurement, representation, and calculation. They seemed to be part of the new character of calculability, in Simmel’s phrase, that would define the politics of the twentieth century. But what precisely was new? There had been modern maps of different parts of the country for several decades, and the calculation of land areas and tax liabilities in the Nile valley was probably the oldest continuous example of administrative practice in the world. A closer look at what was novel in the making of the cadastral map offers us a way to understand the new practices of calculation that contributed to the twentiethcentury making of the economy.
zh: 这些地图的制作引入了新的测量、表征和计算形式。它们似乎属于齐美尔所谓新的可计算性品格，这一品格将界定20世纪的政治。但究竟什么是新的？几十年来已有该国不同地区的现代地图，而尼罗河谷土地面积和纳税义务的计算，也许是世界上最古老的连续行政实践。仔细考察地籍图制作中的新颖之处，为我们提供了一条途径，去理解那些促成了20世纪经济制造的新计算实践。

en: The cadastre, or official register of landholders, their lands, and their tax liabilities, was a long-standing institution, renewed with each foreign conquest of the country. When the Ottomans seized Cairo and the Nile Delta in 1517 they ordered a survey of landholdings that took sixty years to complete in the Delta and another thirty to extend toward the south. No new survey was carried out prior to the French occupation three centuries later.

Mehmed Ali ordered a cadastral survey and compiled a new tax register in 1813. All these surveys involved measuring the size of each plot in each village under Cairo’s authority, and recording the total land and tax liability of every household and village. The information was recorded in village registers and in a government register in Cairo. It was never depicted on maps.
zh: 地籍册，即土地持有者、其土地及纳税义务的官方登记，是一种由来已久的制度，每次外国征服该国时都会重新编制。1517年奥斯曼人夺取开罗和尼罗河三角洲后，下令进行一次土地占有调查，在三角洲花了六十年才完成，又花了三十年向南扩展。三个世纪后法国占领之前，没有再做过新的调查。
穆罕默德·阿里于1813年下令进行一次地籍测量，并编制了新的税收登记册。所有这些调查都涉及测量开罗管辖下每个村庄每一块地的面积，并记录每户和每村的总土地与纳税义务。信息记录在村庄登记册和开罗的政府登记册中，从未描绘在地图上。

en: Mapping the countryside was probably attempted for the first time in 1853–59, when Mehmed Ali’s successors carried out a comprehensive new cadastral survey. But the mapmaking was soon abandoned in favor of the old method of recording landholdings in registers, and any maps produced were lost. In 1858 a team of astronomers and surveyors began a detailed topographic study of the country. This provided information for a fortyfive-square-meter relief map of the Delta and Middle Egypt that was the centerpiece in the palace representing modern Egypt at the famous 1867 World Exhibition in Paris.
Maps of the Delta were eventually published in 1871, although on a scale too small to show landholdings. The mapping of the south was never completed.
zh: 对乡村进行测绘，也许最早尝试于1853—1859年，当时穆罕默德·阿里的继任者进行了一次全面的新地籍测量。但制图工作很快被放弃，重新采用登记册记录土地占有的旧方法，制作出来的地图也遗失了。1858年，一支天文学家和测量员队伍开始对该国进行详细的地形研究。这为三角洲和中埃及一幅四十五平方米的地形模型图提供了资料，该图是1867年巴黎世界博览会上代表现代埃及的宫殿中的核心展品。
三角洲地图最终于1871年出版，但比例尺太小，无法显示土地占有情况。南方的测绘从未完成。

en: The failure to produce a cadastral map continued after the Europeans took direct control. The Anglo-French Debt Commission and the International Inquiry that took over the country’s revenues in 1878 ordered a land survey based on maps. The mapping was interrupted the following year when Ismaʿil, the Ottoman viceroy in Cairo, dismissed the Europeans and briefly put in charge an American (whose survey work the British later declared unreliable). It was slowed after Ismaʿil’s deposition and Britain’s military occupation, by the budget cuts of 1883, and by a cholera epidemic the same year that took more than fifty thousand lives. It was finally abandoned in 1888 with less than one-sixth of the country’s agricultural area mapped.
zh: 欧洲人直接控制之后，地籍图制作的失败仍在继续。1878年接管该国税收的英法债务委员会和国际调查委员会下令进行以地图为基础的土地测量。次年，奥斯曼总督伊斯梅尔解雇欧洲人，短暂任命一位美国人负责（英国后来宣布其测量工作不可靠），测绘因此中断。伊斯梅尔被废黜和英国军事占领之后，测绘又因1883年的预算削减和同年夺走五万多人生命的霍乱疫情而放慢。1888年，测绘最终被放弃，已测绘的农业区域不到全国六分之一。

en: A decade later, with the collaboration of the Debt Commission, the new British survey began. Unlike earlier attempts at map making, the survey was based upon triangulation.

Instead of starting at the level of each village and building the map, plot by plot, by taking measurements with wooden rods or iron chains, the surveyors first laid a grid that would extend over the entire Nile valley. Using theodolites and signaling mirrors set up on the desert plateau on either side of the cultivated riverbanks, they established a network of lines each up to twenty-five kilometers long, crisscrossing the valley and connected into triangles from whose angles the length of each line could be determined. These they subdivided into smaller triangles with sides of about 3.5 kilometers. Individual villages, fields, and plots were then fixed within this triangulate web, the surveyors measuring each plot with chains and checking position and accuracy by further triangulation, establishing triangles within triangles within triangles. The “great land map of Egypt,” as the Geographical Journal in London called it, would be based for the first time on a “rigorous framework” and “planned upon [a] connected system.”
zh: 十年后，在债务委员会的协作下，新的英国测量开始了。与早先的制图尝试不同，这次测量以三角测量为基础。

测量员不是从每个村庄的层面开始、用木杆或铁链测量、逐块拼成地图，而是先铺设一张覆盖整个尼罗河谷的网格。他们在耕作河岸两侧的沙漠高原上架设经纬仪和信号镜，建立了一个由各长达二十五公里的线条组成的网络，线条纵横交错于河谷，连接成三角形，从三角形的角度可以确定每条线的长度。他们再把这些三角形细分为边长约3.5公里的较小三角形。单独的村庄、田地和地块随后被固定在这张三角网中，测量员用测链丈量每一块地，并通过进一步的三角测量——三角形套三角形——来核对位置和精度。伦敦《地理学杂志》所称的“埃及大地图”，将首次建立在一个“严密的框架”和“按相互连接的系统规划”的基础上。

en: The accuracy of the framework depended on the precise measurement of the baseline of its first triangle. The base was laid out along a railway track at Giza, near Cairo, in 1898, using five-meter laminated fir rods fitted with steel points at each end. The rods were checked against a standard bar that had been obtained forty years earlier from the firm of Brünner in Paris for the 1858 mapping project, and was itself sent back to Europe to be checked at different air temperatures against standards in Paris and Madrid. After measuring the Giza base, the survey office was dissatisfied with the accuracy of the rods and decided to replace them with a pair of 100-meter brass and steel Jäderin wires ordered from Stockholm, but these did not arrive until 1906. So for their second baseline, established at Seila in Fayyum Province in 1900, they used a 100-meter steel tape. The director of the survey, Captain Henry Lyons, gives the following account of how the base was measured. Along the baseline, approximately three kilometers (two miles) in length,
zh: 这一框架的精度，取决于对其第一个三角形基线的精确测量。基线于1898年在开罗附近的吉萨沿一条铁路铺设，使用五米长的层压冷杉尺杆，两端装有钢尖。这些尺杆用一根标准杆校准；该标准杆是四十年前为1858年的测绘工程从巴黎布伦纳公司购得的，其本身又被送回欧洲，在不同气温下与巴黎和马德里的标准器进行校准。测量吉萨基线之后，测量局对这些尺杆的精度不满意，决定改用从斯德哥尔摩订购的一对100米长的黄铜与钢制耶德林线尺，但这些线尺直到1906年才运到。因此，1900年在法尤姆省塞拉建立第二条基线时，他们使用的是一条100米长的钢卷尺。测量局局长亨利·莱昂斯上尉对基线的测量过程有如下记述。沿着这条全长约三公里（两英里）的基线，

en: stout wooden pickets were driven into the ground at intervals of a tapelength apart. On the head of each picket was nailed a plate of zinc, with fine cross lines ruled on it the intersection of which marked the point at which the measurement was to be made. The base was levelled on August 10, 1900, and the measurements occupied the following two days, one being made at dawn before the sun rose, and the other after sunset, since the sandy desert became so intensely heated by the sun’s rays during the daytime as to render it inadvisable to measure between sunrise and sunset. The air temperature was determined for each tapelength by sling thermometers used at each end of the tape.
zh: 每隔一个尺长，粗壮的木桩被钉入地下。每根桩顶钉一块锌板，板上划有细十字线，其交点标出测量点。基线于1900年8月10日整平，测量在此后两天进行：一次在日出前的黎明，另一次在日落之后；因为白昼阳光把沙质沙漠晒得极热，不宜在日出至日落之间测量。每到一个尺长，都通过测尺两端使用的摇转温度计测定气温。

en: With his British assistants and team of locally recruited chainmen, Lyons stretched and supported the tape by having it
zh: 莱昂斯在英国助手和当地招募的测链员队伍的协助下，拉伸并支托测尺，办法是

en: laid on blocks of wood of triangular section, in order to reduce friction as much as possible, so that it rested on the wooden edges of the blocks, and only for about two-thirds of its length on the surface of the desert;
zh: 把测尺放在三角形截面的木块上，以尽可能减少摩擦，使测尺由木块的木质边棱支承，只有约三分之二的长度接触沙漠表面；

en: it was strained to uniformity of tension by means of a spring balance during the first two measurements, and to 15 kilograms during the last two. Uniformity of tension was secured by having the tape raised clear of the ground just before the measurement by three chainmen at equal intervals, who then lowered it gently into position.
zh: 前两次测量时用弹簧秤将测尺拉伸至张力一致，后两次则拉至15公斤。每次测量前，由三名测链员等距将测尺抬离地面，然后轻轻放下就位，以保证张力一致。

en: Repeating this procedure between each of the thirty pickets, the surveyors read off the difference between the end of the tape and the crosshairs marked on each picket head, “with the aid of finely-divided ivory scales.” The results were adjusted for the inaccuracy of the tape, the tape’s tension, the air temperature, the difference in level along the line, and the height above sea level. After taking the average of the dawn and evening measurements, writes Lyons, “we obtain for the length of the Seila base: 2,902.474 metres ± 0.0043 metre.”
At the end of three days work, they had measured a line almost two miles long to within an accuracy of oneeighth of an inch.
zh: 测量员在三十根木桩之间逐一重复这一程序，借助“刻度精细的象牙尺”，读出测尺端部与每根桩顶所标十字线之间的差值。测量结果按测尺误差、测尺张力、气温、沿线高差以及海拔高度作了校正。莱昂斯写道，在对黎明和傍晚的测量取平均值之后，“我们得到塞拉基线的长度：2,902.474米±0.0043米。”
经过三天工作，他们测量了一条近两英里长的基线，误差不超过八分之一英寸。

en: This kind of precision was repeated in the theodolite traverses and chain measurements, and in the offices of the survey in Cairo, where the figures from notebooks compiled in the field were transcribed, computed, and checked. Great accuracy and speed were achieved, it was said, “by instituting an almost mechanical system of work, and by carrying the principle of the division of labour to its extreme possible development.”The mechanical organization of labor made this human calculating machine self-checking, so that “any part not up to the requisite standard was automatically rejected.”

The measurements and computations were then translated into the twenty thousand separate map sheets, which together for the first time made the country available in the form of a continuous “paper landscape.”

The information on property owners and tax liabilities was compiled as an index to the maps. It was organized into two different kinds of register. The main register, for each village in the country, listed the land of the village, by field (hod) and plot, and for each plot listed up to twenty-five items of information, including area, class of land, tax, owner, and occupier. The second register listed the same information organized by landowner.
zh: 这种精度也体现在经纬仪导线测量和测链测量中，体现在开罗测量局的办公室里——外业笔记本中的数字在那里被誊录、计算和核查。据说，“通过建立一套近乎机械的工作制度，并把分工原则推行到其可能的极致”，测量工作获得了极高的精度和速度。劳动的机械化组织使这台“人类计算机器”能够自我校验，因此“任何达不到规定标准的部分都会被自动剔除”。
测量和计算随后被转化为两万幅单独的地图；这些地图合在一起，首次使整个国家以连续的“纸面景观”形式呈现出来。
关于土地所有者和纳税义务的信息被汇编为地图索引。它被编成两种不同的登记册。主登记册按全国每个村庄列出该村的土地，按田（hod）和地块编排；每一地块最多列出二十五项信息，包括面积、土地等级、税额、所有者和占有者。第二本登记册按土地所有者编排同样的信息。

en: As a method of producing official knowledge of the country, the cadastral map was considered to have four advantages. The first lay in its spatial presentation of landownership. The old tax registers could record the dimensions of every plot of land and relate each plot to an owner, but could not indicate the relationship between one plot and another. The new map showed not only the size of a particular landholding, but also its relation to all the others. The simultaneous presentation of adjoining plots produced a new kind of knowledge, the knowledge of irregularity. Since tax rates were based on the quality of the land, and plots in the same field tended to be of similar quality, “any anomalies in the rate of tax are at once visible.”

In this way the map revealed facts that were previously invisible. The spatial display could show other distinctive or anomalous features, such as areas of land under reclamation that might need reassessment in future years. And as Lyons pointed out, it would now be impossible to record the same plot of land twice under different owners.

More importantly, although Lyons did not mention this, the map made immediately visible any plot of cultivated land that had not been registered under an owner, and was thus evading taxation. This was information the old cadastral register could never produce.
zh: 作为一种生产关于国家的官方知识的方法，地籍图被认为有四项优势。第一项在于它以空间方式呈现土地所有权。旧的税收登记册能够记录每块土地的尺寸，并把每块地与一位所有者联系起来，却无法标明一块地与另一块地之间的关系。新地图不仅显示某处地产的大小，也显示它与所有其他地产的关系。相邻地块的同时呈现产生了一种新知识，即关于不规则性的知识。由于税率以土地质量为基础，而同一田内的地块质量往往相近，“税率上的任何异常都立刻显现”。
地图由此揭示了此前不可见的事实。空间展示还能显示其他有辨识度或异常的特征，例如未来年份可能需要重新估税的正在开垦的土地。而且正如莱昂斯所指出的，此时已不可能把同一块土地两次登记在不同所有者名下。
更重要的是，尽管莱昂斯没有提及这一点，地图使任何未登记在所有者名下的耕地立刻变得可见，这些土地因此逃避了征税。这是旧地籍册永远无法产生的信息。

en: Political power now had a new form: the knowledge and command of space. The old cadastre was assembled from a knowledge of households and villages. Land claims and tax liabilities were the claims and liabilities of communities of persons, and expressed the relations of those communities both to the land and to those in power. Movements of information, revenue, and control flowed through these relations. Under the new system, the list of persons was merely “complementary” to the map, supplying additional information “that could not conveniently be inserted on the plan of a piece of land.”

Power over persons was to be reorganized as a power over space, and persons were merely the units arrayed and enumerated within that space. The spatial order of knowledge was reflected in the method of mapmaking. The survey began by establishing coordinates not within the village but across the entire country, built upon a “rigorous framework.” It recorded every community in terms of its graticulation within this nationwide context. The nation was emerging as this space, this material/structural extension, within which villages, persons, liabilities, and exchanges could be organized and contained. The connections, linkages, commands, and flows of information that made up this political order no longer seemed to pass through particular persons and communities. They appeared to arise in the space of separation between the land and the map, the social community and the state, the revenue and its statistical representation.
zh: 政治权力此时有了新的形式：对空间的知识与掌控。旧地籍册是由关于家户和村庄的知识汇编而成的。土地主张和纳税义务是人的共同体的主张和义务，表达了这些共同体与土地以及与掌权者之间的关系。信息、收入和控制的流动贯穿于这些关系之中。在新制度下，人的名单只是地图的“补充”，提供“无法方便地插到某块土地的平面图上”的附加信息。

对人的权力将被重组为对空间的权力，人只是排列并清点于该空间之中的单位。知识的空间秩序反映在地图制作方法中。测量从确定坐标开始，这些坐标不是在村庄之内，而是覆盖整个国家，建立在一个“严密的框架”之上。它以每个共同体在这一全国性格局中的格网坐标来记录它。民族正作为这样一个空间、这样一种物质／结构性的延展而出现；村庄、人、义务和交换都可以在其中被组织并容纳。构成这一政治秩序的联系、联结、命令和信息流动，似乎不再经过特定的人与共同体。它们似乎产生于土地与地图之间、社会共同体与国家之间、税收与其统计表征之间的分离空间。

en: A second advantage the surveyors claimed was that the map made visible and recorded the tremendous changes that had occurred over the previous generation. The thousands of hamlets created to house workers on the new estates (the ʿizbas discussed in chapter 2), which had developed outside and largely at the expense of the existing system of village communities, and thus outside the system of village surveying, were named and attached to villages. New boundaries of each village were established topographically and their land area was mapped and measured. The irrigation works that accompanied the creation of private estates had reorganized the old system of flood basins into which landholdings had previously been grouped. In many cases the basins no longer provided a coherent division of the land, so holdings were reorganized into standardized parcels of fifty to one hundred acres. For each of these parcels the names of the landowners were inscribed and then listed in corresponding registers, fixing the land as a system of objects to be possessed and exchanged.
zh: 测量员主张的第二项优势是，地图使上一代期间发生的巨大变化变得可见并记录下来。为新地产上的工人修建的数千个小村落（即第二章讨论的伊兹巴），是在既有村庄共同体体系之外发展起来的，并且很大程度上以该体系为代价，因此也处在村庄测量体系之外；这些村落被命名，并被划归到各个村庄。每个村庄的新边界经地形测量确定，其土地面积被测绘和丈量。伴随私人地产的建立而修建的灌溉工程，重组了此前土地持有被归组其中的旧洪泛盆地体系。许多情况下，这些盆地不再能对土地作出连贯的划分，因此土地持有被重组为五十至一百费丹的标准化地块。对每个这样的地块，土地所有者的姓名被刻记下来，随后列入相应的登记册，从而把土地固定为一个由可占有、可交换的客体构成的体系。

en: What the surveyors saw as recent changes, however, as I discussed in chapter 2, were at the same time a series of exceptions. The estates had come into being through the exercise of arbitrary and often violent forms of power, whether through grants from the ruler or the prerogatives of the European-controlled Mixed Courts. The mapping erased the signs of this arbitrariness, removing the scars, the abnormalities, through which the violence could still be traced. By giving each estate an official name and set of boundaries, and intercalating each one among the old system of village names and land claims, the arbitrariness of large landownership was merged into a uniform national space and made invisible. If the map made some kinds of abnormality newly visible, it made other forms disappear. Later on, when the economy comes into being, it will not be just a new and more detailed set of representations. Like the map, it will occur as practices that redistribute forms of knowledge and ignorance, and rearrange the normal and the abnormal.
zh: 然而，如我在第二章所论，测量员视为近期变化的这些现象，同时又是一系列例外。这些地产是通过行使专断且往往暴力的权力而形成的，或依靠统治者的赐予，或依靠欧洲人控制的混合法院的特权。测绘抹去了这种专断的痕迹，消除了那些仍可据以追溯暴力的创疤、异常。通过给每处地产一个官方名称和一套边界，并把它们逐一编入旧有的村名和土地主张体系之中，大土地所有制的专断性被并入均质的国家空间，变得不可见。如果说地图使某些类型的异常新近变得可见，那么它也让另一些形式消失了。后文将表明，当经济形成时，它不会只是一套新的、更详细的表征。像地图一样，它将作为一些实践而发生：这些实践重新分配知识与非知识的形式，并重新安排正常与异常。

en: A third advantage of the map was claimed not directly in the official account, but by implication. The map moved the site where all this knowledge was held. The old cadastre rested on the knowledge of the village surveyors. These men possessed a vital skill, especially in the south, where the Nile flood still inundated most of the fields each year. After the floodwaters had drained away, the surveyors marked out the plots along the dikes. The same expertise produced the old cadastral registers, and was still relied upon for local assistance in producing the new cadastral maps. The maps were made in the same years as the building of the first Aswan dam. As we know, the dam was to reorganize the distribution of expertise, taking away most of the local knowledge of flood basin irrigation, distributed along the length of the river, and concentrating technical control at one site.

After its raising in 1912 and 1933, the dam left only one-fifth of the land under flood basin irrigation, so the annual work of local surveyors was also taken away. The map contributed in its own way to a similar redistribution of knowledge. The cadastral knowledge of the village surveyors was now to be transferred into the map. The reason for the “mechanical” level of accuracy in the survey work was that the map had to be precise enough to allow the area of a plot, and thus the tax liability of its owner, for the first time to be calculated from the map itself. Instead of measuring the land, tax officials would measure the map.
zh: 地图的第三项优势并未在官方记述中直接主张，而是隐含其中。地图转移了存放这一切知识的地点。旧地籍册以村庄测量员的知识为基础。这些人掌握一项至关重要的技能，在南方尤其如此，那里的尼罗河洪水每年仍淹没大部分田地。洪水退去后，测量员沿堤坝标出各地块。同样的专门知识曾产生旧的地籍登记册，在制作新地籍图时也仍然依靠它提供地方协助。这些地图的制作与第一座阿斯旺大坝的修建发生在同一些年份。如我们所知，大坝将重组专门知识的分布：剥夺沿河分布的关于洪泛盆地灌溉的大部分地方知识，把技术控制集中于一地。
在1912年和1933年两次加高之后，大坝使只剩五分之一的土地仍处于洪泛盆地灌溉之下，地方测量员的年度工作也随之被剥夺。地图以自己的方式促成了类似的知识重新分配。村庄测量员的地籍知识此时要被移入地图之中。测量工作中“机械式”精度水平的原因在于，地图的精确度必须足以使人们首次能够根据地图本身计算一块地的面积，从而计算其所有者的纳税义务。税务官员将不再丈量土地，而是丈量地图。

en: A final advantage the map seemed to have, it follows, was its unprecedented degree of accuracy. The first chapters of Lyons’s account of the project were devoted to a history of surveying in Egypt, beginning with the Pharaonic system and moving on to the Coptic methods of measuring and calculating area. These methods were still in use as Lyons began his survey, including the survival of Coptic notation in arithmetic, despite efforts since Mehmed Ali in the early part of the century to eliminate the use of Coptic numerals in surveying (the Coptic fractions had survived). Lyons described what he considered the inaccuracies of the Coptic method of calculating area before going on to chronicle the failures of nineteenth-century attempts to introduce more modern methods, leading to his own survey, presented as the culmination of this history of increasing precision, and thus representing the most complete and accurate measurement of the land.
zh: 由此看来，地图似乎还有最后一项优势：它前所未有的精确程度。莱昂斯对该项目的记述，开头几章专门讲述埃及测量史，从法老时期的制度开始，继而论及科普特人的丈量和面积计算方法。莱昂斯开始测量时，这些方法仍在使用，包括算术中科普特记数法的存留；尽管自19世纪初穆罕默德·阿里以来，人们一再努力在测量中废止科普特数字（科普特分数则保留了下来）。莱昂斯描述了他认为的科普特面积计算方法的不精确之处，随后记述19世纪试图引入更现代方法的一次次失败，最后引出他自己的测量；他把这次测量呈现为这段精度不断提高的历史的顶点，因而代表着对土地最完整、最精确的测量。

en: Yet the historical presentation of the cadastre in terms of the evolution of precision—as another history of abstraction, that is, another account of the growing power of human reason to order and take the measure of the world—hid something. Lyons could not claim, in fact, that the survey he directed resulted in a more accurate measure of the land. Accuracy is always a question of where one stands. As we shall see, the new maps were in significant ways less accurate and more cumbersome than the old methods of recording landholdings. However, thanks to the gap opened up between field and map, the question of accuracy could now be recast. It was now an issue of one, simple relationship: the correspondence between the map and “the real world.”
zh: 然而，以精度的演化来呈现地籍册的历史——也就是把它写成又一部抽象的历史，又一种关于人类理性安排世界并测量世界的力量不断增长的叙述——掩盖了某些东西。事实上，莱昂斯无法声称他所主持的测量带来了对土地更精确的丈量。精确性始终取决于站在什么位置。我们将会看到，新地图在重要方面不如旧的土地持有记录方法准确，而且更加笨重繁琐。然而，由于现场与地图之间被打开了一道裂隙，精确性问题此时可以重新表述。它此时变成一个简单的关系问题：地图与“真实世界”之间的对应。

en: The twentieth century’s new regime of calculation did not produce, necessarily, a more accurate knowledge of the world, despite its claims, nor even any overall increase in the quantity of knowledge. Its achievement was to redistribute forms of knowledge, increasing it in some places and decreasing it in others. At the same time, it transferred this knowledge to new sites. By a series of removals, it opened up a certain distance, the distance between the field and the computing office, between the farmer and the colonial survey officer, between the iron triangulation marker and the paper map.

The distance of such removals, repeated countless times in the cadastral survey and in increasing numbers of other projects, was to have a strange effect. The act of removal began to appear not as an action but as something more profound. The distance from the field to the map and back again, from the village to the computing office, would come to mark what seemed an absolute gap: the divide between reality and its representation, between an image-world and its object. The question of accuracy or truth could now be cast as the degree of correspondence between the objectworld on one side of this divide and the maps, images, and numbers on the other. This strange effect gave rise to new objects and forms of calculation—among the most important of them, the economy.
zh: 20世纪新的计算体制尽管有其宣称，却未必产生对世界更准确的知识，甚至没有使知识的总量有任何整体增长。它的成就在于重新分配知识的形式，在有些地方增加，在另一些地方减少。与此同时，它把这些知识转移到新的地点。通过一连串的抽离，它打开了一段距离：现场与计算办公室之间的距离，农民与殖民地测量官之间的距离，铁制三角测量标志与纸面地图之间的距离。

这种抽离所造成的距离，在地籍测量以及越来越多的其他工程中被无数次重复，将产生一种奇怪的效果。抽离的行为开始不再显得是一种行动，而显得是某种更深刻的东西。从现场到地图再返回现场、从村庄到计算办公室的距离，将标示出一道看似绝对的鸿沟：现实与其表征之间的分界，一个影像世界与其对象之间的分界。精确性或真理的问题此时可以被表述为：鸿沟一方的对象世界与另一方的地图、影像和数字之间的对应程度。这种奇怪的效果催生了新的对象和计算形式——其中最重要的之一便是经济。

en: an organization of things and powers
zh: 物与权力的组织

en: Surely, it may be said, even if an object called the economy was not named before the middle decades of the twentieth century, and the statistical practices that measured it had not yet been developed, nevertheless there was plenty of activity of an economic nature in earlier periods, and governments tried to regulate and even direct this activity. In that sense the economy was always there, one could argue, and the transformation I am describing occurred more at the level of ideas and representations than in material and political relations themselves.
zh: 人们也许会说，诚然，即使一个叫作“经济”的对象在20世纪中叶之前未曾被命名，衡量它的统计实践也尚未发展起来，但较早时期仍存在大量具有经济性质的活动，政府也曾试图规制乃至引导这些活动。有人可以论证，在这个意义上，经济始终存在，而我所描述的转变更多发生在观念和表征层面，而不是物质关系和政治关系本身。

en: It is certainly true that many of the activities that contributed to the making of the economy had long histories. But it would be a mistake to minimize in this way the importance of the change that occurred. There was no economy before the twentieth century because the economy belonged to a world that was being reorganized around a new axis, the axis that appears to divide the world into image and object, representation and reality. This could not be a transformation only at the level of representations, for the modern belief in a disembodied yet secular realm of representation was one of the outcomes of this kind of transformation. Many quite real things had to be reorganized to make the world appear to separate cleanly along its new divide.
zh: 确实，许多促成经济形成的活动都有着悠久的历史。但以这种方式低估所发生的变化的重要性，将是错误的。20世纪之前没有经济，因为经济属于一个正围绕新轴线被重组的世界，这条轴线似乎把世界分为影像与对象、表征与现实。这不可能只是一场发生在表征层面的转变，因为现代对于一种无形体却又世俗的表征领域的信念，正是这类转变的产物之一。为了让世界显得沿其新的分界线干净地分开，许多相当真实的事物必须被重新组织。

en: The great land map of Egypt was not just a new way of representing an existing object, private property. The map helped to constitute and consolidate the new institution of private property and the forms of debt, title, dispossession, and violence on which it depended. Ordered by the Debt Commission, the maps in particular enabled the commissioners to reestablish boundaries for the hundreds of thousands of acres of state domain, many parts of which had been encroached upon, or reclaimed, by local farmers, and to begin auctioning these former khedival estates to private investors.

Thus mapping played a role in producing the distinction between land as “mere object” and the abstractions of law, taxation, and title. Likewise the making of the economy was not just a new way of representing certain forms of production and exchange, but part of a general reorganization of forms of calculation, appropriation, and government.
zh: 埃及大地图不只是表征一个既存对象（私有财产）的新方式。地图帮助构成并巩固了私有财产这一新制度，以及它所依赖的债务、产权、剥夺和暴力形式。尤其是这些地图，它们应债务委员会之命制作，使委员们能够为数十万费丹国有领地重新确定边界——其中许多部分曾被当地农民侵占或开垦——并开始把这些原属总督的产业拍卖给私人投资者。
因此，测绘在制造“单纯客体”的土地与法律、税收和产权的抽象之间的区分方面发挥了作用。同样，经济的制造不只是表征某些生产与交换形式的新方式，而是对计算、占有和治理形式进行总体重组的一部分。

en: In the case of Egypt, I have stressed the importance of landed property in forming a new space of economic processes, to be imagined and organized as the economy.
However, private landownership was connected with a series of further transformations that were to form, and be formatted, as the national economy.
zh: 就埃及而言，我已经强调了土地产权在形成经济过程的新空间方面的重要性——这个空间可被想象并组织为经济。
然而，私有土地所有权还与一系列进一步的转变相联系，这些转变将构成国民经济，并被按照国民经济的格式来塑造。

en: First, there was the increasingly widespread cultivation of cotton, which by the second decade of the century accounted for 92 percent of the country’s recorded exports of goods.

A century earlier in England, when Ricardo first outlined a simplified idea of the making of wealth as the expanding control of agricultural land and the consequent increase in agricultural income, his model of the circulation of wealth was based on the cultivation and consumption of a single product, wheat.

With the expansion of large landownership in England, the wheat crop had replaced a more diversified grain agriculture and played a dominant role in farming, trade, and consumption. So perhaps it seemed reasonable, especially to an immigrant banker turned estate owner like Ricardo, to simplify the circulation of wealth to the movements of a single commodity.
zh: 首先是棉花种植日益广泛；到20世纪第二个十年，棉花已占该国有记录商品出口的92%。
一个世纪前的英格兰，李嘉图最初勾勒出一种简化的财富创造观念，即财富创造在于对农业用地控制的扩张以及随之而来的农业收入增长；他的财富流通模型以单一产品小麦的种植和消费为基础。
随着英格兰大土地所有制的扩张，小麦作物取代了较为多样化的谷物农业，在耕作、贸易和消费中扮演主导角色。因此，把财富的流通简化为单一商品的运动，也许看起来是合理的，尤其是对像李嘉图这样由移民银行家转变为地产主的人来说。

en: This situation had changed dramatically in the 1870s. In a single decade, from 1868 to 1878, Britain went from producing four-fifths of its basic food and fiber to producing scarcely one-half.

In the same decade, the tradition of political economy built on the work of Ricardo was put aside (except by Marx) as a new professional economics began to emerge. Stanley Jevons, Karl Menger, and Leon Walras laid the foundation of the new profession by abandoning the image of wealth making based on land acquisition and the grain cycle and proposing in its place, as I mentioned, a mathematical model of the act of exchange, simplified into an action involving a single buyer, a single seller, and a single, unnamed commodity.
It was no longer possible to consider material relations to be expressed by one dominant commodity, such as wheat, so economists narrowed the study of wealth to this contentless act of exchange.
zh: 1870年代，情况发生了剧烈变化。在1868年至1878年这十年间，英国从生产自身所需基本食物和纤维的五分之四，变为勉强生产一半。
同一十年间，随着新的专业经济学开始兴起，建立在李嘉图著作基础上的政治经济学传统被搁置一旁（马克思除外）。斯坦利·杰文斯、卡尔·门格尔和莱昂·瓦尔拉斯抛弃了以土地获取和谷物周期为基础的财富创造图景，转而提出——如我所提到的——交换行为的数学模型，把它简化为只涉及一个买者、一个卖者和一种未具名商品的行动，从而为新专业奠定了基础。
此时已不可能再把物质关系视为由小麦这样一种主导商品所表达，于是经济学家把财富研究收窄为这种无内容的交换行为。

en: In Egypt, however, the transformations of the 1870s had worked differently, and brought the country closer than perhaps any other place in the world to the old Ricardian idea of wealth as the expansion of private property and the circulation of a single commodity. The creation of private property transferred most of the power to choose what crops to grow from those who cultivated them to a new person, the landowner. The transfer and concentration of power, together with the irrigation works allowing year-round cultivation, led to the replacement of food crops with cotton production across large areas of the countryside. As agricultural production, at least that part that served the market, tended toward monoculture, cotton began to provide a single commodity that could be taken to represent economic processes as a whole. In March 1910, an article in the second issue of the journal of the Society for Political Economy, L’Egypte Contemporaine, noted, “To study the economic situation in Egypt comes down to studying the agricultural situation, for the development of every branch of commerce and industry, the situation of the banks and property companies, in one word, the wealth of the country and its general prosperity, depends almost exclusively on the cotton crop and the price at which it is sold.”

The importance acquired by cotton made possible a new kind of calculation. It made it possible to simplify and homogenize economic relations by representing their complexity in the form of a single commodity. Once again, the forms of calculation whose genealogy we are tracing did not emerge as a new representation of existing realities, but in new arrangements that would help simplify the world into reality and its calculation.
zh: 然而在埃及，1870年代的转变以不同方式发生，使该国也许比世界上任何其他地方都更接近李嘉图关于财富的旧观念，即财富是私有财产的扩张和单一商品的流通。私有财产的创设，把选择种植何种作物的大部分权力从耕种者手中转移给一个新的角色——土地所有者。权力的转移与集中，加上使常年耕作成为可能的灌溉工程，导致广大乡村地区以棉花生产取代粮食作物。随着农业生产——至少是其中面向市场的部分——趋于单一种植，棉花开始提供一种可用来代表整个经济过程的单一商品。1910年3月，政治经济学学会会刊《当代埃及》第二期刊登的一篇文章指出：“研究埃及的经济状况，归结为研究农业状况，因为商业和工业各部门的发展、银行和地产公司的状况，一言以蔽之，国家财富及其普遍繁荣，几乎完全取决于棉花收成及其出售价格。”
棉花所获得的重要性，使一种新的计算成为可能。它使人能够通过以单一商品的形式表征经济关系的复杂性，来简化和同质化这些关系。再一次，我们正在追溯其谱系的各种计算形式，并非作为既存现实的新表征而出现，而是出现在一些新的安排之中；这些安排有助于把世界简化为现实及其计算。

en: There were several other new arrangements that developed in this period related to the regime of private property and the monoculture of cotton, all mentioned in the passage just quoted: the new world of property companies, local and foreign banks, and commercial houses. These multiplied around the turn of the century and produced in turn a new kind of demand for statistical information. At the same time, their own activities provided a set of processes for such statistics to represent.
zh: 这一时期还发展出其他几种新的安排，与私有财产制度和棉花单一种植相关，刚才引用的那段话都提到了：地产公司、本地和外国银行以及商行构成的新世界。它们在世纪之交大量增加，进而产生了一种对统计信息的新需求。与此同时，它们自身的活动提供了一组可供此类统计来表征的过程。

en: The joint stock company was a critical development. The Cairo bourse was founded in the 1890s to enable these companies to trade their shares and raise capital. By the early twentieth century it was one of the three or four most active stock exchanges in the world. The capital of joint stock companies established in Egypt or conducting their primary activities there doubled in two decades, it was reported, from £19,357,358 sterling in 1882 to £40,372,347 in 1902, and more than doubled again in just five years, to £92,617,219 in 1907.

Most of this capital was held by property development companies, involved in both rural land development and building and speculation in new urban neighborhoods of Cairo, and by mortgage companies (the latter accounted for £30 million sterling of the £52 million increase in capital from 1902 to 1905). So the proliferation of joint stock companies was connected with the new regime of private landed property and the growth of the metropolis.
zh: 股份公司是一项关键发展。开罗证券交易所创立于1890年代，使这些公司能够交易其股份并筹集资本。到20世纪初，它已是世界上交易最活跃的三四家证券交易所之一。据报道，在埃及设立或在埃及开展主要业务的股份公司资本，在二十年间翻了一番，从1882年的19,357,358英镑增至1902年的40,372,347英镑，又在仅仅五年间增长一倍多，到1907年达到92,617,219英镑。
这些资本大部分由房地产开发公司持有——它们既参与乡村土地开发，也参与开罗新城区建设与投机——以及抵押贷款公司（1902年至1905年间资本增加的5,200万英镑中，后者占3,000万英镑）。因此，股份公司的激增与私有土地产权的新制度以及大都市的增长相关联。

en: Joint stock companies were a new kind of semipublic institution. Historically, it should be noted, the limited liability company was not a private institution that began to open its ownership to the public. It was a form of public institution taken over by private interests. Before the later nineteenth century, the legal privileges of corporate existence and limited liability were granted only for purposes that could be portrayed as a benefit to the public. In England limited liability corporations could be established only by an act of Parliament and were created for public works such as canal, railway, harbor, and bridge building, and above all for colonization.

The oldest and largest of the British colonizing corporations, the East India Company, had played an important role in producing the modern science of economics. Three leading nineteenth-century political economists, James Mill, Robert Malthus, and John Stuart Mill, spent their working lives as employees of the company, and after its nationalization and renaming as the India Office, as we know, it gave the most famous economist of the twentieth century his first employment. In Egypt from the 1890s, this form of public/private body also played a role in the generation of economic knowledge. It generated a new public of shareholders, and the managers and directors answerable to them, whose financial decisions required the publication of share prices, financial results, and other kinds of statistical information, as well as general information about the financial and political condition of the country.
zh: 股份公司是一种新型的半公共机构。应当指出，从历史上看，有限责任公司并非一种开始向公众开放所有权的私人机构。它是被私人利益接管的一种公共机构形式。19世纪后期之前，法人资格和有限责任的法律特权，只授予那些可被描述为有益于公众的用途。在英格兰，有限责任公司只能通过议会法案设立，且是为运河、铁路、港口和桥梁建设等公共工程而创设，尤其是为殖民而创设。

英国最古老、最大的殖民公司东印度公司，在现代经济学科学的形成中发挥了重要作用。19世纪三位领军政治经济学家詹姆斯·密尔、罗伯特·马尔萨斯和约翰·斯图尔特·密尔，都以该公司雇员的身份度过其职业生涯；该公司国有化并更名为印度事务部之后，如我们所知，又为20世纪最著名的经济学家提供了第一份工作。1890年代起在埃及，这种公私混合机构也在经济知识的生成中发挥作用。它产生了一类新的公众——股东，以及对他们负责的经理和董事；这些人的财务决策需要公布股价、财务结果及其他种类的统计信息，还有关于该国财政和政治状况的一般信息。

en: The financial and commercial activities related to the economics of cotton production in the countryside, including investment and speculation in land, were imagined to have their location in the country’s expanding cities of Cairo and Alexandria. Whatever the actual location of the cotton, the processing industries, the speculation, and the money, if these diverse materials and activities were imagined to have a single location, it was the city. In fact the idea of the city offered both a parallel and an alternative to landed property as a space that gave concrete and visual form to the new relations of wealth creation. Simmel’s essay with which we began this chapter proposed a special relationship between “money economy” and the mental or cultural life of those who inhabit the large city. Prior to the making of the economy in its mid-twentieth-century meaning, the idea of the metropolis could be used in this way to imagine the density and tangibility of economic relations. In the formative decades of the professional social sciences, sociologists were preoccupied with the question of the city. It held a place later to be filled by the idea of the economy.
zh: 与乡村棉花生产的经济运作相关的金融和商业活动——包括土地投资和投机——被想象为位于该国不断扩张的开罗和亚历山大港这两座城市。无论棉花、加工业、投机和资金实际位于何处，如果这些多样的物质与活动被想象为有一个单一场所，那就是城市。事实上，城市观念既与土地产权相平行，又作为其替代，提供了一种使新的财富创造关系获得具体可见形式的空间。本章开头讨论的齐美尔文章，提出“货币经济”与大都市居民的精神或文化生活之间存在一种特殊关系。在20世纪中叶意义上的经济被制造出来之前，大都市观念可以这样用来想象经济关系的密度与可触知性。在专业社会科学的形成时期，社会学家全神贯注于城市问题。它占据的位置后来由经济观念填补。

en: How was this density of the economic imagined? How were certain everyday transactions among people and things to become something as solid and tangible as “the economy”? How was the economy to be made into an object, something people would take to be real? Simmel’s essay on the city suggests part of the answer. In the metropolis, Simmel wrote, ideas and values took on the appearance of objects. A dense built environment generated what he called “objective culture.” Objective culture, or objective spirit, referred to the way in which ideas and values no longer seemed to reside within the individual, but to have migrated into the bodies of things. The institutions, buildings, and technologies of the city seemed to be more than just physical structures. They were themselves a form of “spirit” or “life.” In the metropolis, “the development of modern culture is characterized by the preponderance of what one may call the ‘objective spirit’ over the ‘subjective spirit,’ “ Simmel wrote.
zh: 这种经济性的密度是如何被想象的？人与物之间某些日常交易，如何变成像“经济”一样坚实、可触的东西？经济如何被制造成一个对象，某种人们会当作真实的东西？齐美尔论城市的文章暗示了部分答案。齐美尔写道，在大都市，观念和价值披上了对象的外观。稠密的建成环境产生了他所谓的“客观文化”。客观文化或客观精神，指的是观念和价值似乎不再居于个人之内，而是迁入了物的身体。城市的制度、建筑和技术似乎不只是物理结构。它们本身是一种“精神”或“生命”的形式。齐美尔写道，在大都市，“现代文化的发展特征，是人们所谓‘客观精神’对‘主观精神’的压倒性优势。”

en: The individual has become a mere cog in an enormous organization of things and powers which tear from his hands all progress, spirituality, and value in order to transform them from their subjective form into the form of a purely objective life. It needs merely to be pointed out that the metropolis is the genuine arena of this culture which outgrows all personal life. Here in buildings and educational institutions, in the wonders and comforts of space-conquering technology, in the formations of community life, and in the visible institutions of the state, is offered such an overwhelming fullness of crystallized and impersonalized spirit that the personality, so to speak, cannot maintain itself under its impact.
zh: 个人已变成庞大物与权力组织中的一个单纯齿轮；这个组织从他手中夺走一切进步、精神性和价值，把它们从主观形式转变为纯粹客观生命的形式。只需指出，大都市是这种超越一切个人生活的文化的真正舞台。在这里，在建筑与教育机构中，在征服空间的技术奇观与舒适中，在共同体生活的形成中，在国家可见的制度中，展现出如此压倒性地充实的结晶化、非人格化精神，以至于可以说，人格在这种冲击下无法维持自身。

en: The terms of Simmel’s argument sound strange today. We no longer talk of a world full of crystallized spirit (or rather, when we do we no longer use those words). The phrasing reflects Simmel’s effort to describe “an enormous organization of things and powers,” which had not yet been named “the economy.” Yet this world already appeared to be dividing along the axis that would make it possible to fabricate the economy. It was a world of things and powers, a world in which the quality of being objectified belonged to ideas as well as things. Ideas and values no longer belonged to individuals, just as the measurements of the fields were no longer the property of village surveyors. New forms of architecture, engineering, science, schooling, statistical knowledge, finance, commerce, and government were ordering up a world in which buildings, educational establishments, technologies, commercial houses, and the “visible institutions of the state,” in Simmel’s phrase, presented to the individual what now looked like an “objective culture.” The metropolis appeared divided into these two dimensions: on the one hand, its material fabric of buildings, institutions, and technologies, on the other the “crystallized spirit” that these new spaces and structures seemed to embody.
zh: 齐美尔论证的用语今天听起来很古怪。我们不再谈论一个充满结晶化精神的世界（或者更确切地说，即使我们这样谈论，也不再使用那些词）。这种措辞反映了齐美尔试图描述“庞大的物与权力的组织”，它尚未被命名为“经济”。然而这个世界似乎已经沿一条轴线分裂，而这条轴线将使制造经济成为可能。这是一个物与权力的世界，一个客体化属性既属于观念也属于物的世界。观念和价值不再属于个人，正如田地的测量不再属于村庄测量员。建筑、工程、科学、学校教育、统计知识、金融、商业和政府的新形式，正在编排出一个世界；在其中，建筑、教育设施、技术、商行以及齐美尔所说的“国家可见的制度”，向个人呈现了此时看来像“客观文化”的东西。大都市显得划分为两个维度：一方面是建筑、制度和技术的物质织体，另一方面是这些新空间与新结构似乎体现的“结晶化精神”。

en: For Simmel, this separation can be understood only as the result of an act of alienation. Ideas and values—the forms of “spirit” taking on an objective existence—must previously have resided within the individual, from whose hands, or mind, they have now been torn. There is no reason for us to subscribe to this thesis of alienation. No doubt this is how the new world was experienced, for it was a place increasingly organized to isolate and create a sense of lack or absence within the individual. It would be more reasonable to assume, however, that forms of ideality and value, the occurrence of the metaphysical and the meaningful, were always distributed much more widely in the world, never simply locked inside people’s heads. The new “organization of things and powers”—the new institutions of government, architecture of the metropolis, and forms of money economy—like the new methods of the cadastral survey, were redistributing ideas and values in a simplified way, to manufacture the apparent separation of objects and values, things and powers. Only a world reorganized to generate this simple two-dimensional effect could give birth to the economy.
zh: 对齐美尔而言，这种分离只能被理解为一种异化行为的结果。观念和价值——采取客观存在的“精神”形式——必定先前居于个人之内，如今从其手中或头脑中被夺走。我们没有理由赞同这种异化论。无疑，这就是新世界被经验的方式，因为这个场所日益被组织起来，以便在个人之内造成孤立，并制造一种匮乏或缺失感。然而，更合理的假设是，观念性与价值的形式，形而上之物与有意义之物的出现，始终在世界中分布得广泛得多，从未只是锁在人们的头脑之内。新的“物与权力的组织”——新的政府制度、大都市建筑和货币经济形式——像地籍测量的新方法一样，正在以简化的方式重新分配观念和价值，以制造对象与价值、物与权力之间表面上的分离。只有一个被重组以产生这种简单二维效果的世界，才可能诞生经济。

en: Another turn-of-the century development in Cairo, also connected with the property regime, the growth of the city, and land speculation, both enabled and demanded a new range of statistical information: the introduction of a single national currency and of paper money. The circulation of a national currency was to provide the critical means to imagine, and to format, the twentieth-century economy.
zh: 世纪之交开罗的另一项发展，同样与产权制度、城市增长和土地投机相关，既使一系列新的统计信息成为可能，也要求这些信息：单一国家货币和纸币的引入。国家货币的流通将提供关键手段，用来想象并格式化20世纪的经济。

en: Mehmed Ali Pasha had introduced his own money system in 1834, based on a gold coin of one pound. But this coexisted with other Ottoman and European coins, many of which were no longer legal tender in Europe or traded at different values from their European value. An 1885 law refixed the value of the Egyptian pound and determined which other kinds of coin would be accepted in public accounts and at what value. Despite these reforms Egyptian pounds did not circulate in large quantities. The British preferred to deal in the gold coins (chiefly British sovereigns) that flowed into the country each year with the export of the cotton crop.

The situation began to change from 1898, however, when the statutes of the privately controlled National Bank of Egypt were approved, with the right to issue banknotes. The bank was required to cover half the value of the notes in circulation with reserves of gold. By 1914 there were only E£2.4 million in banknotes in circulation, but thereafter the volume rose rapidly, reaching E£12.65 million by the end of January 1916 and E£67 million by 1919.
zh: 穆罕默德·阿里帕夏于1834年推行自己的货币制度，以一枚一镑金币为基础。但这种金币与其他奥斯曼和欧洲硬币并存，其中许多已不再是欧洲的法定货币，或以与其欧洲价值不同的价值交易。1885年的一项法律重新确定埃及镑的价值，并规定公共账目中接受哪些其他种类的硬币以及按什么价值接受。尽管有这些改革，埃及镑并未大量流通。英国人更愿意使用金币（主要是英国索维林），这些金币每年随棉花出口流入该国。
然而，从1898年起情况开始变化：私人控制的埃及国家银行章程获得批准，被授予发行纸币的权利。该银行须以黄金储备覆盖流通中纸币价值的一半。到1914年，流通中的纸币仅有240万埃及镑，但此后数量迅速上升，到1916年1月底达到1,265万埃及镑，到1919年达到6,700万埃及镑。

en: If the system of landed property brings into being a topographical space that defines the extension of economic processes, the cadastral survey translates this into a paper landscape, cotton production generates a simplified measure of the production and circulation of commodities, and the building of the metropolis provides a material expression of the intensity and expansion of exchange relations, paper currency plays another part in the formatting of social processes as an economy. The new money forms a system of circulation, one that somehow occurs both as the movement of wealth and its representation. It seems to work on two levels of representation. First, the notes themselves are a representation. They circulate as a system of financial signs that carry value because of the reserves of gold to which they refer. Second, since these signs are more mobile than the old forms of gold coinage, the volume of the notes moved and the velocity of their movement become themselves a system of signs. From 1914, the Ministry of Finance in Cairo began to publish statistical tables of credit and circulation. These showed figures for the annual circulation of banknotes since 1900, as well as the gold reserves and other deposits of the bank, together with data for the current year indicating the circulation of banknotes month by month. This picture of the circulation of money, the government suggested, could be used to measure the general activity of “the Egyptian market.”
The following year it proposed that the same statistics be used as “a barometer of the financial situation of the country.”
zh: 如果说土地产权制度产生了一个界定经济过程范围的地形空间，地籍测量把它转化为纸面景观，棉花生产产生了衡量商品生产与流通的简化尺度，大都市的建造为交换关系的强度与扩张提供了物质表达，那么纸币则在把社会过程格式化为经济方面发挥另一重作用。新货币构成一个流通体系，这个体系以某种方式既作为财富的运动，又作为其表征而发生。它似乎作用于两个表征层面。首先，纸币本身是一种表征。它们作为一套金融符号流通，其价值来自它们所指涉的黄金储备。其次，由于这些符号比旧式金币更具流动性，转移中的纸币数量及其转移速度本身成为一套符号体系。从1914年起，开罗的财政部开始发布信贷与流通统计表。这些表格显示自1900年以来纸币年度流通量的数字，以及该银行的黄金储备和其他存款，还有当年逐月纸币流通的数据。政府提出，这幅货币流通图景可用来衡量“埃及市场”的一般活动。
次年，它提议把同样的统计用作“国家财政状况的晴雨表”。

en: When John Maynard Keynes began to write of an object called “the economy” in the 1930s, he introduced the term when searching for ways to account for the special nature of money, whose significance Walrasian theory had been unable to grasp. As we saw, these were issues that had preoccupied him since before World War I, when he tried to understand the peculiar problems of finance in colonial India. The statistical figures with whose help the economy was gradually constructed—national income (later called the gross national product), investment, savings, and money supply—were all measures of the movement of money from hand to hand within the nation. In its basic form, the economy was conceived as the sum of every occasion on which money changed hands. Since money works, as I just mentioned, on two levels of representation, once again we should not understand the emergence of the economy in terms of the distinction between new economic practices and their representation. The representational forms of money bring into being the new kinds of movement that will be figured as the economy. The separation of the economic from its representations is not a single line dividing the material world from a world of ideas, or the economy from economics. It is an uncertain difference established in multiple places within those practices that form the economy. One more factor played a role in the production of the new object of knowledge, and indeed was an aspect of all of those already discussed: Egypt’s colonial condition. Colonialism had helped institute the regime of private property and the monoculture of cotton; European-owned property companies and banks had driven the speculative growth of Cairo; large European financial houses owned the country’s debt and had demanded the cadastral survey and the production of many other forms of statistical information; and European speculators were largely responsible for the growth of the stock market and the increasing circulation of paper money. Whether organized from Cairo or the European capitals, this colonial activity was the activity of outsiders, those for whom Egypt itself existed as an object of speculation, investment, government—and curiosity. Foreign investors and colonial administrators shared with visiting archaeologists and tourists an outsider’s fascination with Egypt as a strange and unusual “case.” L’Egypte Contemporaine welcomed the publication of the Annuaire Statistique in 1910, with its wealth of social facts, saying
zh: 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯在1930年代开始写到一种叫作“经济”的对象时，是在寻找解释货币特殊性质的方法的过程中引入这个词的，而瓦尔拉斯理论一直未能把握这种特殊性质。如我们所见，这些问题自第一次世界大战前就萦绕着他，当时他试图理解殖民地印度的独特金融问题。帮助经济逐渐建构起来的统计数字——国民收入（后来称为国民生产总值）、投资、储蓄和货币供应量——都是对货币在一国之内从一只手转到另一只手的运动的衡量。在其基本形式中，经济被设想为货币每一次易手之场合的总和。既然如我刚刚提到的，货币在两个表征层面上运作，我们就不应再一次把经济的出现理解为新经济实践与其表征之间的区分。货币的表征形式产生了将被构想为经济的那些新型运动。经济与其表征之间的分离，并不是一条把物质世界与观念世界、或把经济与经济学分开的单一界线。它是在构成经济的那些实践内部多个位置确立起来的一种不确定的差异。还有一个因素在这种新知识对象的生产中发挥作用，而且它实际上是前面所讨论的一切因素的一个方面：埃及的殖民处境。殖民主义帮助建立了私有产权制度和棉花单一种植；欧洲人拥有的地产公司和银行推动了开罗的投机性增长；欧洲大型金融商行持有该国债务，并要求进行地籍测量和生产许多其他形式的统计信息；欧洲投机者在很大程度上促成了股票市场的增长和纸币流通的扩大。无论从开罗还是从欧洲各国首都组织，这种殖民活动都是外来者的活动，对他们而言，埃及本身作为投机、投资、治理——以及好奇——的对象而存在。外国投资者和殖民官员与来访的考古学家和游客一样，以局外人的眼光迷恋埃及，把它看作一个奇特而不寻常的“案例”。《当代埃及》欢迎1910年《统计年鉴》的出版，称其包含丰富的社会事实，并说

en: there are few countries where some of these facts present themselves with a relief as striking, sometimes also as strange, as in Egypt. Her situation and geographical particularities, the character of her present activity, the diversity of races that live there, make Egypt interesting not only to the archaeologist and tourist. It is also, for the economists and sociologists of all countries, one of the most fascinating crossroads of the modern world.
zh: 很少有国家像埃及这样，其中某些事实以其同样醒目、有时也同样奇异的方式突显出来。她的处境和地理特性、她当前活动的性质、居住在那里的种族的多样性，使埃及不仅对考古学家和游客具有吸引力。对世界各国的经济学家和社会学家来说，它也是现代世界最迷人的十字路口之一。

en: I suggested earlier that Keynes’s experience in the problems of colonial financial administration may have been significant in the later development of his work. Colonialism opened up a distance, a space of separation, a relationship of curiosity, that made it possible to see something as “a case,” a self-contained object whose “problems” could be measured, analyzed, and addressed by a form of knowledge that appears to stand outside the object and grasp it in its entirety.
zh: 我先前提出，凯恩斯在殖民金融管理问题上的经验，可能对他后来工作的发展具有重要意义。殖民主义打开了一段距离、一个分离的空间、一种好奇的关系，使人们有可能把某物看作“案例”，即一个自成一体的对象，其“问题”可以由一种似乎站在对象之外、并把对象作为一个整体来把握的知识来测量、分析和处理。

en: This colonial relationship with India or Egypt as a peculiar social and economic case was gradually supplemented by an increasing demand from the major powers and the international organizations they established for statistical information making every country in the world comparable. Some of this demand goes back to the late nineteenth century. The establishing of the country’s first Bureau de Statistique in 1870 directly followed the khedive’s visit to the Exposition Universelle in Paris, where the presentation of statistical data on each country in the world was one of the organizing principles of the exhibition.

The Statistique de l’Egypte published for three years (1870–72) by E. de Regny, the Frenchman appointed to head the bureau, presented material modeled on that of the world exhibitions. It was collected not for internal administrative purposes but to present at future exhibitions, beginning with the Vienna World Exhibition.
zh: 这种把印度或埃及当作独特社会和经济案例的殖民关系，逐渐得到补充：列强及其建立的国际组织日益要求提供使世界上每个国家都可比较的统计信息。其中一些需求可追溯至19世纪后期。该国第一个统计局于1870年设立，直接起因是总督访问巴黎世界博览会；在那届博览会上，展示世界上每个国家的统计数据是组织原则之一。
被任命为统计局局长的法国人E. 德·雷尼在三年间（1870—1872）出版了《埃及统计》（Statistique de l'Egypte），其呈现材料的方式模仿世界博览会。这些材料不是为内部行政目的而收集，而是为了在未来的博览会上展示，首先是维也纳世界博览会。

en: In the twentieth century the international demand for countries to produce statistical representations of themselves became more frequent and systematic. In 1922 the new International Labour Office in Geneva asked member states to compile national figures on population movement. The International Institute of Agriculture in Rome, forerunner of the FAO, organized world agricultural censuses in 1929 and 1939, which were the reason for the only surveys of this sort that Egypt carried out in the interwar period. The Middle East Financial Conference, convened in Cairo by Britain and the United States in 1944, called on governments in the region to collect and publish accurate banking statistics, showing all debits to current accounts, so that “changes in the velocity of circulation of bank deposits can be kept fully under review as an indicator of the volume of business activity.”

It called for bank balance sheets to be published in the standard form drawn up by the League of Nations in 1934, and for improved statistics on balance of payments. The conference also called for the compilation of statistics on national income and output, and proposed that countries send staff to be trained in this new statistical practice in London or Washington, so that the accounts would be produced in a uniform (and Anglo-American) way.

In response to this proposal, following the war the Egyptian Ministry of Finance sent an employee to complete a doctorate at the University of London, where he produced as his thesis the first systematic study of Egypt’s national income.
zh: 在20世纪，要求各国生产关于自身的统计表征的国际需求变得更加频繁和系统。1922年，日内瓦新成立的国际劳工局要求成员国汇编全国人口变动数字。罗马的国际农业研究所（联合国粮农组织的前身）于1929年和1939年组织了世界农业普查；埃及在两次世界大战之间开展的唯一这类调查，正是由此而来。1944年，英国和美国在开罗召开中东金融会议，呼吁该地区各国政府收集并公布准确的银行统计，列明活期账户的全部借项，以便“把银行存款流通速度的变化作为一种商业活动量的指标，始终保持充分审视”。
会议呼吁按国际联盟1934年制定的标准格式公布银行资产负债表，并改进国际收支统计。会议还呼吁汇编国民收入和产出的统计，并提议各国派员到伦敦或华盛顿接受这种新统计实践的培训，以便以统一（且是英美式）的方式编制这些账户。
为回应这一提议，埃及财政部在战后派一名雇员到伦敦大学攻读博士学位；他在那里完成了埃及国民收入的第一个系统研究，作为博士论文。

en: Landed property, cotton production, joint stock companies, the speculative growth of Cairo’s built environment, and the increasingly rapid circulation of money provided a series of processes that constituted new fields of social and economic calculation. Colonialism provided an effect of separation, like that between the village and the survey office, that helped establish this space of calculability as an object. The fields of calculation contributed to their own “objectivation” by collecting and putting into circulation the statistical information on which they depended. In 1905, the government set up a Statistics Office, which published its first Annuaire Statistique (Statistical Yearbook) in 1909.

The statistics service was initially an office within the Survey Department, which was part of the Ministry of Finance. The location was partly a practical matter. As the cadastral survey reached completion in 1907, some of its personnel became available for other kinds of statistical work.

But it also reflected the continuity between the statistical work of the survey and the emergence of a new kind of economic calculation within the country. In 1911 the Statistics Office became a department of its own within the Ministry of Finance. The statistics that the government produced, moreover, were made available by a new method of circulation. The statistics published in the early years of the Annuaire Statistique represented information that ministries and other public bodies had already been collecting on activities such as the railways, the cotton trade, and import duties, much of it assembled on the orders of foreign creditors who had been allotted the income from these sources. The Department of Statistics lacked the resources to conduct largescale studies of its own, and no legislation was provided to compel public or private bodies to supply it with information. Nor did it benefit from any system of local government, or local business or agricultural syndicates, as found in many parts of Europe, engaged in their own collection of data on which the central statistics office could draw. In its early years, therefore, the Statistics Office was largely restricted to the role of obtaining information collected internally by other government departments, by the customs and excise authority, by public bodies such as the railways, telegraphs, and telephone, and by shipping and other joint-stock companies. This information was gathered together and published as the Annuaire Statistique.
zh: 土地产权、棉花生产、股份公司、开罗建成环境的投机性增长以及日益加快的货币流通，提供了一系列过程，构成社会与经济计算的新领域。殖民主义提供了一种分离效果，如同村庄与测量局之间的分离，帮助把这一可计算性空间确立为一个对象。这些计算领域通过收集并让它们所依赖的统计信息进入流通，促成了自身的“客体化”。1905年，政府设立统计局，并于1909年出版第一本《统计年鉴》（Annuaire Statistique）。
统计局起初是测量局内部的一个办公室，测量局隶属于财政部。这一安排部分出于实际考虑。随着地籍测量于1907年完成，其部分人员可以腾出手来从事其他种类的统计工作。

但这也反映了测量局的统计工作与国内一种新型经济计算的出现之间的连续性。1911年，统计局成为财政部内一个独立的司局。此外，政府编制的统计通过一种新的流通方式提供给人们。《统计年鉴》早些年公布的统计，是各部委和其他公共机构已经就铁路、棉花贸易和进口关税等活动收集的信息，其中许多是奉外国债权人之命汇编的，而这些债权人已被分配了来自这些来源的收入。统计局缺乏独立开展大规模研究的资源，也没有立法强制公共或私人机构向其提供信息。它也未能受益于欧洲许多地方存在的那种地方政府或地方工商业、农业协会体系——这些机构自行收集数据，供中央统计局利用。因此，在早些年，统计局的作用大体限于获取其他政府部门、关税与消费税局、铁路、电报和电话等公共机构以及航运公司和其他股份公司内部收集的信息。这些信息被汇集起来，作为《统计年鉴》出版。

en: What characterized this new statistical process, therefore, was not the collecting of such information so much as the act of making it public. On the eve of his retirement as director of the Statistics Department in 1924, I. G. Lévi noted that the department
