zh: 因此，这一新统计过程的特征，与其说是收集此类信息，不如说是将它们公之于众的行为。1924年，I. G. 莱维在即将从统计局局长职位退休之际指出，该局

en: each year puts into print at least 7,800 manuscript pages of figures, amounting to more than three million numbers per year or 10,000 numbers per day, which it must calculate, register, verify, and transcribe! It prints in its offices some 11,000 reports and has 32,000 books or pamphlets distributed by the press each year. It receives, reads, and files a little under one million documents per year, sends more than 6,000 letters, and receives 10,000.
zh: 每年付印至少7,800页数字手稿，合计每年300多万个数字，即每天10,000个数字，而它必须计算、登记、核实并誊录这些数字！该局在局内印刷约11,000份报告，并每年由印刷所分发32,000册书籍或小册子。它每年接收、阅读并归档近100万份文件，发出6,000多封信函，收进10,000封。

en: Statistics were no longer just to serve the administrative needs of the individual departments or organizations that collected them. They were to be put together and circulated, partly for the benefit of other departments of the state and partly for making arguments to the political powers in the metropole, but also for a new kind of user—the public. In the same way, the new Société d’Economie Politique declared that its role was to study questions of political economy, statistics, and legislation, “for the instruction not only of its members but also of the public.”

The Annuaire Statistique was published partly to meet this same demand. L’Egypte Contemporaine welcomed the Annuaire as “the essential foundation for all economic and social study relating to Egypt.” It added that such studies were important not only for residents of the country but “for so many others who have sent their capital there or conduct commercial relations with it, and follow anxiously from outside the fluctuations of its wealth and of its economic progress.”
The statistical information, as this suggests, did not simply represent a preexisting sphere of economic activity. It helped to bring this sphere, with its anxious participants, into being.
zh: 统计不再只是服务于收集它们的个别部门或组织的行政需要。它们要被汇集并流通，部分是为了国家的其他部门，部分是为了向宗主国的政治权力提出论据，但也是为了一个新类型的用户——公众。同样，新成立的政治经济学学会宣布，其作用是研究政治经济学、统计和立法问题，“不仅为了教育其会员，也为了教育公众”。
出版《统计年鉴》部分是为了满足同样的需求。《当代埃及》欢迎《年鉴》，称其为“一切有关埃及的经济和社会研究的基本基础”。它补充说，这类研究不仅对该国居民重要，也“对如此之多的人重要——他们把资本送到那里，或与那里从事商业往来，并从外部焦急地关注其财富和经济进展的波动”。
如这表明的，统计信息并不只是表征一个预先存在的经济活动领域。它帮助这个领域及其焦虑的参与者得以形成。

en: This new concern, not just to collect statistical data but to have it in regular circulation among “the public,” seems to distinguish the use of statistics in the twentieth century from earlier practices, at least in the case of Egypt. Colonial powers had long made use of statistics, whether for administrative needs or to produce a larger “illusion of bureaucratic control.”

Toward the end of World War I, as Britain and other colonial powers faced a harder task in justifying the continuation of colonial occupation, new statistical work could clarify the purpose and authority of imperial government.

But the circulation of statistics among a “public,” like the newly visible circulation of currency, enabled them to take on the form of an “objective culture,” something with a solidity or substance of its own. One could begin to conceive of the gap that seems to set this circulating body of information apart from the processes and activities it refers to. The gap appears as a divide between two worlds, a sphere of figures, numbers, facts, and trends on the one side, and the world to which these refer on the other. The latter must stand as its opposite, the realm of the material, the real.
zh: 这种新的关切——不仅收集统计数据，而且让其定期在“公众”中流通——似乎把20世纪统计的使用与早先的实践区分开来，至少在埃及的情形中如此。殖民列强长期以来一直利用统计，或为行政需要，或为制造更大范围的“官僚控制幻象”。
第一次世界大战临近结束时，随着英国和其他殖民列强在证明继续殖民占领的正当性方面面临更困难的任务，新的统计工作能够阐明帝国政府的目的与权威。
但统计在“公众”中的流通，如同货币新近可见的流通一样，使统计能够采取“客观文化”的形式，成为某种自身具有坚实性或实质的东西。人们开始能够设想一道裂隙，它似乎把这一流通中的信息体与被它指涉的过程和活动分隔开来。这道裂隙显得是两个世界之间的分界：一边是数字、数目、事实和趋势的领域，另一边是这些所指涉的世界。后者必然作为它的对立面，即物质与真实的领域。

en: At this point, in the early decades of the twentieth century, there was no single term for this realm. Writings I have already quoted indicate the variety of phrases used to invoke the object to which this emerging sphere of representation referred. The phrase “the Egyptian market” was used occasionally, although the term “market” did not have the abstract force it would take on at the end of the twentieth century. “The wealth of the country and its general prosperity,” the “social condition and general economics of the country,” its “wealth and economic progress,” and its “economic situation” were among the other expressions writers used. Just as often they invoked phrases like the one that launched L’Egypte Contemporaine, “the problems of national life.”

The Annuaire Statistique of 1914, which was twice the length of earlier volumes and introduced the use of graphs and introductory essays summarizing the statistical picture, suggested that these “taken together form a summary of the general situation of the country and show the progress of each of the branches of its activity.”

The word economy itself was not used in any of these senses: in English, French, and Arabic it still carried the older meaning of management or the conserving and rational use of resources, and it did not necessarily refer to what were now sometimes called “economic” issues. The Société d’Economie Politique divided its activities into three sections, which it termed the Section de Legislation, the Section d’Economie Politique (later adding “et Statistique”), and the Section d’Economie Sociale.
Social economy and political economy were terms referring to the sound government or arrangement of affairs, not to “the economy” as an object or sphere.
zh: 此时，即20世纪最初几十年，这个领域还没有一个单一名称。我已引用过的著述表明，人们用了各种说法来指称这个新兴表征领域所指涉的对象。“埃及市场”这一说法偶尔被使用，尽管“市场”一词尚未具有它在20世纪末将获得的抽象力量。“国家财富及其普遍繁荣”“该国的社会状况与总体经济”“其财富与经济进步”以及“其经济状况”，是写作者使用的其他一些表达。他们也同样频繁地使用诸如《当代埃及》创刊时所使用的“国民生活的问题”之类的说法。
1914年的《统计年鉴》篇幅是早先各卷的两倍，并开始使用图表和概述统计图景的导论性文章；它认为这些内容“合在一起构成对国家总体状况的概述，并显示其活动各个分支的进展”。
economy一词本身并未在上述任何意义上使用：在英语、法语和阿拉伯语中，它仍带有管理、或对资源进行节约和合理利用的较早含义，未必指此时有时被称为“经济”的问题。政治经济学学会将其活动分为三个组：立法组、政治经济组（后来加上“与统计”）、社会经济组。
社会经济学和政治经济学这些术语，指的是对事务的妥善治理或安排，而不是作为一个对象或领域的“经济”。

en: Even a generation later, toward the end of World War II, the use of the word “economy” to indicate something that could be managed and made to grow was an Anglo-American neologism that did not always survive translation into French and Arabic. In 1944 the Middle East Financial Conference published policy recommendations to enable Middle Eastern countries after the war “to expand their economies.” The French translation rendered this phrase as “de renforcer leur economie” and the Arabic as “tanmiyat quwaha al-iqtisadiyya” (to develop their economic forces).

Within a few years, however, the term economy was widely used in Arabic, but almost always in phrases such as “the national economy” (al-iqtisad al-qawmi) rather than standing alone. In 1950 the Statistical Department, along with the State Domains Administration, the Fisheries Service, and the Department of Tourism, were joined together to form the Ministry of National Economy (still without a definite article in the English translation).

In December of the same year, the country’s leading newspaper, alAhram, began to publish its business supplement as a separate monthly magazine. Initially it kept the old name, al-Ahram fikhidmat al-tijara waʾl-sinaʿa (al-Ahram in the Service of Commerce and Industry). A year later, expanded in size, it added beneath this title the motto “A monthly magazine dealing with affairs of the national economy.” Two years later, following the July 1952 military coup, it changed its name to al-Ahram aliqtisadi. The lead story of its first issue following the coup was headlined “The national economy in the new era.”
zh: 甚至一代人之后，即第二次世界大战临近结束时，用“economy”一词表示某种可以被管理并使之增长的东西，仍是一个英美新词，在译成法语和阿拉伯语时并不总能保留下来。1944年，中东金融会议公布了政策建议，以使中东国家在战后“扩大它们的经济”。法语把它译为“de renforcer leur économie”（加强它们的经济），阿拉伯语译为“tanmiyat quwaha al-iqtisadiyya”（发展它们的经济力量）。
然而，几年之内，economy一词在阿拉伯语中被广泛使用，但几乎总是出现在“国民经济”（al-iqtisad al-qawmi）之类的短语中，而不是单独使用。1950年，统计局与国有领地管理局、渔业局和旅游局合并，组成国民经济部（其英文译名仍未带定冠词）。

同年12月，该国主要报纸《金字塔报》开始把其商业副刊作为独立的月刊出版。起初它保留旧名 al-Ahram fi khidmat al-tijara waʾl-sinaʿa（“服务于商业与工业的《金字塔报》”）。一年后，该刊扩充篇幅，在此标题下加上题词“一本讨论国民经济事务的月刊”。两年后，1952年7月军事政变之后，它更名为 al-Ahram al-iqtisadi（《金字塔经济报》）。政变后第一期头条标题为“新时代的国民经济”。

en: reading difficulties
zh: 阅读困难

en: Producing this new object of calculation was not an easy process. The difficulty lay in a particular feature of the way the new statistical practices emerged. I have described some of the processes that defined the space of economic and social relations and gave them a movement and circulation that could be measured. But these same processes giving rise to a character of calculability created other effects that undermined the fixed and measurable nature of such relations. Private property, monoculture, the stock exchange, paper currency, and colonial power all began to contribute to forms of movement, instability, and crisis that destabilized the process of making a world of calculation.
zh: 生产这一新的计算对象并非易事。困难在于新统计实践出现方式的一个特征。我已描述了一些过程，它们界定了经济与社会关系的空间，并赋予这些关系一种可测量的运动与流通。但产生可计算性品格的这些同样过程，也造成了其他效果，削弱了此类关系固定而可测量的性质。私有财产、单一种植、证券交易所、纸币和殖民权力，都开始促成各种形式的运动、不稳定和危机，动摇制造一个计算世界的进程。

en: The difficulties can be seen with particular clarity in the cadastral survey. Lyons noted that “the country is ever becoming more densely populated and every portion of the cultivable land is being reclaimed as fast as circumstances admit.” The maps could not keep pace with the changes, and they themselves became overcrowded and “confusing to read.” The difficulty was compounded, Lyons felt, by the fact that maps were annotated in Arabic, which, he believed, “does not possess the numerous different types of letters that are available in European writing.”

Further difficulties arose from the tiny size of the plots: in 1907 40 percent of holdings were under half an acre and 90 percent under five acres, a fragmentation increasing as more land was concentrated into larger estates, leaving the majority of the rural population less and less to share.
zh: 这些困难在地籍测量中尤为清楚。莱昂斯指出，“该国人口日益稠密，每一部分可耕地都在情况允许的范围内尽快被开垦。”地图无法跟上这些变化，而且它们本身变得过于拥挤，“难以阅读”。莱昂斯认为，地图以阿拉伯文标注这一点加重了困难；他相信阿拉伯文“不具备欧洲书写中可用的那么多不同种类的字母字形”。
进一步的困难来自地块的面积极小：1907年，40%的土地持有不足半费丹，90%不足五费丹；随着越来越多土地集中到更大的地产中，这种细碎化不断加剧，使大多数乡村人口可分享的土地越来越少。

en: Difficulties also arose from the fact that the surveyors were attempting to map not just what was changing, but something contested. The incorporation of land into large estates had exacerbated the problem of boundary disputes. Lyons admitted that where title to the land was unclear, or where encroachment may have occurred, big landowners tended to win out. In the last four years of the survey, the government received 42,962 complaints about inaccuracies in the recording of property boundaries. Some three thousand of these were acknowledged to result from incorrect measurement, but 39,073 were declared unfounded.

Through such declarations, inscribed onto the map, the arbitrariness of the large estates was to be erased. The villagers had no means of appeal, but evidently they developed their own response. At the completion of the survey the government acknowledged the problems of inaccuracy and noted that the third- and fourth-order triangulation, which relied on triangulation points placed within the cultivated area, would have to be redone. It had been impossible to establish permanent points. This was due in part to the character of agriculture in the Nile valley, in which every meter of available land was cultivated and the borders of plots were marked only by irrigation ditches, redug after each flooding or ploughing. There were no hedges or other permanent features marking plot boundaries, which might be used to establish survey points. But it was also due to the fact that the large stones and lengths of angle iron used as survey points were frequently lost, sometimes by accident but “more often by wilful interference.”

In some cases villagers assumed they were boundary markers, and quite sensibly moved them to the edges of their plots. They also found them useful to employ as building materials, or as levers and weights for the irrigation machines they now required to lift canal water into their fields.
zh: 困难还来自这样一个事实：测量员试图测绘的不仅是正在变化的东西，而且是有争议的东西。土地被并入大型地产，加剧了边界纠纷问题。莱昂斯承认，在土地产权不明确、或可能发生侵占的地方，大地主往往胜出。在测量的最后四年里，政府收到42,962起关于产权边界记录不准确的投诉。其中约三千起被确认由测量错误造成，但有39,073起被宣布没有根据。

通过这类被写入地图的宣告，大型地产的专断性将被抹去。村民没有申诉途径，但显然发展出了自己的应对办法。测量完成时，政府承认了不准确的问题，并指出，依靠设置在耕作区内三角测量点的三、四级三角测量将不得不重做。一直无法建立永久测点。部分原因在于尼罗河谷农业的特点：每一米可用土地都被耕种，地块边界仅以灌溉沟渠标示，这些沟渠在每次洪水或耕作后都要重新挖掘。没有树篱或其他标示地块边界的永久性特征，可用来设立测点。但这也因为用作测点的大石块和角铁段经常丢失，有时出于意外，但“更常见的是故意破坏”。
有时村民以为它们是边界标志，便十分合理地把它们移到自家地块边缘。他们还发现这些材料可用作建筑材料，或用作他们此时所需的、把运河水泵入田地的灌溉机械的杠杆和配重。

en: A related source of difficulty was that reorganizing the control of agriculture according to a system of permanent property rights did not stabilize the countryside, despite the new system that identified each plot of land and tied it to a named owner. On the contrary, as we saw in the previous chapter, private property rights led directly to a process of eviction and dispossession of small owners and tenants through debt foreclosure and other mechanisms. By the turn of the century the evictions reached a point of crisis. In 1912 the government was forced to introduce rules to limit the disruption, preventing the eviction of holders of less than five acres or the seizure of their houses, essential farm implements, and working animals. Despite the law, the problem of landlessness continued to grow, producing an ever-larger population of mobile workers and temporary or permanent migrants. This unfixing of the population from the land through the system of private property made subsequent efforts at census taking or the measurement of agricultural income increasingly difficult. By 1950 there was still not even an approximate statistical measure of the size of the landless agricultural labor force. The agricultural censuses of 1929 and 1939 made no attempt to include a survey of the seasonal and migrant work force.

A study published in 1950 tried two different methods of estimating the size (and the income) of the agricultural labor force. One method produced a total about 40 percent higher than the other, and there was no way of deciding between the two figures.
zh: 一个相关的困难来源是，按照永久产权制度重组对农业的控制，并未使乡村稳定下来，尽管新制度辨认出每一块土地并将其与一位具名所有者绑定。相反，如我们在上一章所见，私有产权直接导致小所有者和佃农通过债务止赎及其他机制被驱逐和剥夺的过程。到世纪之交，驱逐达到危机程度。1912年，政府被迫出台规则限制这种破坏，禁止驱逐持有不足五费丹土地的人，或扣押他们的房屋、基本农具和役畜。尽管有这项法律，无地问题仍继续恶化，产生出越来越大的流动工人和临时或永久移民人口。这种通过私有产权制度使人口脱离土地的过程，使此后的人口普查或农业收入衡量日益困难。到1950年，仍然连无地农业劳动力规模的近似统计衡量都没有。1929年和1939年的农业普查没有尝试包含对季节性和流动劳动力的调查。
1950年发表的一项研究尝试用两种不同方法估计农业劳动力的规模（及其收入）。一种方法得出的总数比另一种高约40%，而无法在两个数字之间作出取舍。

en: Another set of problems resulted from the ever-wider cultivation of cotton, as excessive cropping and perennial irrigation caused a series of difficulties. In the first decade of the twentieth century the crop suffered from increasing infestation by the cotton worm, forcing emergency legislation in 1905 to draft every boy between the age of ten and eighteen from agricultural households into compulsory labor in the fields, to remove and burn the infested leaves (boys who refused to be drafted could be imprisoned for up to a week). With no annual flood to fertilize and drain the fields, the soil became poorer and more saline. Crop yields began to decline rapidly, dropping by almost 50 percent from 5.8 qantars (hundredweight) of cotton per acre in 1897 to 3.25 in 1909. To compound the problem there were rapid swings in the price of cotton, from year to year and month to month, producing serious difficulties and sometimes crisis.

The Cotton Commission was set up in 1908 to establish causes for the declining yields but found its work hampered by the lack of accurate statistics on areas planted and yields. This prompted the Survey Department to publish the Collection of Statistics of the Area Planted in Cotton in 1909, which analyzed the accuracy of the data on cultivated areas provided by the village sarraf or tax official. Ernest Dowson, who had succeeded Henry Lyons as director-general of the Survey Department, proposed to improve the reporting by the sarrafs and the interpretation of their reports, in particular by identifying the fields planted with cotton on the Survey Department’s new maps. It was hoped in this way to turn taxation statistics into a source of more general agricultural information, which could be used to address the problems of cotton production.

In 1910, on the recommendation of the Cotton Commission, the British administration agreed to a long-standing demand to establish a Department of Agriculture, to coordinate efforts to stem the decline in cotton yields.
zh: 另一组问题源于棉花种植日益扩大，过度种植和常年灌溉造成了一系列困难。20世纪最初十年，棉田日益遭受棉叶虫侵害，迫使当局于1905年制定紧急立法，征召每一户农家十至十八岁的男孩到田里服劳役，清除并烧毁受虫害的叶子（拒绝应征的男孩可被监禁至多一周）。由于没有年度洪水为田地淤灌和冲洗，土壤变得贫瘠而盐碱化。作物产量开始迅速下降，从1897年每费丹5.8坎塔尔（qantar，英担）棉花降至1909年的3.25坎塔尔，降幅近50%。雪上加霜的是，棉花价格逐年、逐月剧烈波动，造成严重困难，有时酿成危机。

棉花委员会于1908年成立，以查明产量下降的原因，但发现其工作因缺乏关于种植面积和产量的准确统计而受阻。这促使测量局于1909年出版《棉花种植面积统计汇编》，分析村庄的萨拉夫（sarraf，即税务官）提供的耕地面积数据是否准确。接替亨利·莱昂斯担任测量总局局长的欧内斯特·道森提议改进萨拉夫的报告及其报告的解读，特别是借助测量局的新地图确认种植棉花的田块。人们希望以此把税收统计转变为更普遍的农业信息来源，用以处理棉花生产的问题。
1910年，根据棉花委员会的建议，英国当局同意了一项长期要求，设立农业部，以协调遏制棉花产量下降的努力。

en: Similar problems affected the stock market and the new national currency. It used to be thought that the standardization of national currencies made money into a more homogenous, controllable, and therefore countable measure of collective wealth. Simmel’s fear that “money economy” was “transforming the world into an arithmetical problem” became the common view of the homogenizing effects of the new money.

Yet as Zelizer shows in the case of the United States, the standardization of legal forms of money was typically accompanied by a proliferation of other kinds of monies—multiple forms of credit, coupons, tokens, shares, checks, savings schemes, and other varieties of currency, both official and unofficial—which made the circulation and measure of wealth no less heterogenous than before.
The possibility of calculating the “velocity of money” arrived and disappeared at the same time.
zh: 股票市场和新国家货币也受到类似问题的影响。人们过去认为，国家货币的标准化使货币成为衡量集体财富的更同质、更可控、因而更可计量的尺度。齐美尔担心“货币经济”正在“把世界转化为一个算术问题”，这种担忧成为人们看待新货币同质化效应的普遍观点。
然而，正如泽利泽在美国的案例中所表明的，法定形式货币的标准化通常伴随着其他种类货币的激增——多种形式的信贷、票券、代币、股份、支票、储蓄计划，以及其他官方和非官方的货币变体——这使财富的流通和衡量丝毫不比从前更同质。
计算“货币流通速度”的可能性，在出现的同时也消失了。

en: In addition, the speed and volume of circulation even of official forms of currency and wealth produced its own crises. In 1911 the new stock market crashed, forcing dozens of companies into bankruptcy. The Annuaire Statistique, which had prided itself on its increasingly detailed reporting of the activities of joint stock companies, was unable that year to publish any statistics relating to the stock market. Due to “the crisis,” it reported, too many companies had disappeared, merged with others, or been re-formed. The printing of paper money also led to crisis. First there was the surge in prices, especially in the first decade of the century, which resulted in several attempts to develop explanations of the phenomenon. The most popular was to blame it on the abolition of the octroi (the tax on commodities brought into the town from the countryside for sale), which was eliminated from the last two towns, Cairo and Alexandria, at the start of 1903. Yacoub Artin’s “Essai sur les causes du renchérissement de la vie matérielle au Caire” (1908) dismissed this explanation, and produced copious data relating the price inflation to the general increase in population, production, trade, and the size of cities over the preceding decades.

This was very much an explanation in terms of nineteenth-century political economy: the problems caused by paper currency itself, although affecting everyone, were not yet visible to economic analysis. The situation worsened during World War I, when the government quietly ignored its own rule that the printing of money had to be backed by reserves of gold covering 50 percent of its value. The supply of banknotes increased rapidly during the war, as I mentioned, and the increase was backed by British treasury bonds instead of gold. By 1919, when E£67 million in banknotes were in circulation, gold reserves were down to E£3.33 million, or less than 5 percent. Britain had taken the rest of Egypt’s gold to finance the wartime Arab Revolt against the Ottomans. As a result, the Egyptian pound was forced off the gold standard onto a “sterling exchange standard,” exposing the country to all the crises that sterling faced in the interwar period.
zh: 此外，即便是官方形式的货币和财富，其流通的速度与数量本身也产生了危机。1911年，新的股票市场崩盘，迫使数十家公司破产。《统计年鉴》曾以对股份公司活动日益详细的报告而自豪，但那年却无法公布任何与股票市场有关的统计。它报告说，由于“危机”，过多公司已经消失、与其他公司合并或重新组建。纸币的印制也导致了危机。首先是价格飙升，特别是在20世纪最初十年，这促使人们多次尝试解释这一现象。最流行的解释将其归咎于入市税（octroi，即对从乡村运入城镇出售的商品征收的税）的废除；开罗和亚历山大港是最后两个在1903年初取消该税的城市。雅库布·阿尔廷的《开罗物质生活昂贵原因论》（Essai sur les causes du renchérissement de la vie matérielle au Caire，1908）否定了这一解释，并提出大量数据，把通货膨胀与之前几十年人口、生产、贸易和城市规模的普遍增长联系起来。

这完全是一种依据19世纪政治经济学的解释：纸币本身造成的问题虽然影响到所有人，却尚未进入经济分析的视野。第一次世界大战期间情况恶化，政府悄然无视自己制定的规则，即印钞必须以价值50%的黄金储备作担保。如我所述，战争期间纸币供应迅速增加，而其增加以英国国库券而非黄金作担保。到1919年，流通中的纸币达6,700万埃及镑，黄金储备降至333万埃及镑，不足5%。英国取走了埃及其余的黄金，用以资助战时反对奥斯曼人的阿拉伯起义。结果，埃及镑被迫脱离金本位，转而实行“英镑汇兑本位”，使该国暴露于英镑在两次世界大战之间面临的一切危机之中。

en: This range of crises and inexplicable developments made the continuing work of the Statistics Department both more necessary and more difficult. The volatility of economic events made the collection of data more arduous and unreliable. At the same time, the economic crises often deprived the department of the resources or personnel required to collect the information that such crises seemed to demand. There were several attempts to introduce the surveying of prices and to measure the new concept of “cost of living.” The first effort, in 1914, had to be abandoned because the outbreak of war made prices so unstable that they could not be reliably measured. After the war, in 1921, T. L. Bennett, controller of the Statistics Department, managed to compile a survey of consumer prices. But the effort to make this an annual exercise failed when the following year Bennett suffered a “deplorable accident.”
Subsequently the office lacked the resources to continue his work.
zh: 这一系列危机和无法解释的事态，使统计局的持续工作既更有必要，也更加困难。经济事件的剧烈波动使数据收集更加艰苦且更不可靠。与此同时，经济危机常常使该局失去收集危机似乎所需信息的人力或资源。曾有多次尝试引入价格调查，并衡量“生活费用”这一新概念。第一次努力在1914年，不得不放弃，因为战争爆发使价格极不稳定，无法可靠衡量。战后1921年，统计局主管T. L. 贝内特设法汇编了一份消费价格调查。但使之成为年度工作的努力失败了：次年，贝内特遭遇了一场“不幸事故”。
此后该局缺乏继续其工作的资源。

en: Efforts to measure the movement of commerce and population faced similar difficulties. There were good statistics on the export and import of commodities. Giuseppe Randone, a protégé of the famous Italian statistician Luigi Bodio, had been brought to Egypt to help organize the 1882 census and then set up and ran a statistics office for foreign trade within the Alexandria customs office, before becoming the first director of the Central Statistics Office in 1905.

The system of reporting and classifying imports and exports that he set up in Alexandria became a model for other countries. But it did not work elsewhere in Egypt. In 1913 an attempt was made to reproduce a similar system for internal commerce, by carrying out what was intended to be an annual survey of river navigation on the Nile. The attempt was abandoned when the ports and ship owners refused to supply adequate information. Another effort was made to survey this information in 1928, but it was only partially successful.
zh: 衡量商业和人口运动的努力面临类似困难。商品进出口有良好的统计。朱塞佩·兰多内是意大利著名统计学家路易吉·博迪奥的门生，他被带到埃及协助组织1882年人口普查，随后在亚历山大港海关内设立并管理一个对外贸易统计处，之后于1905年成为中央统计局的第一任局长。
他在亚历山大港建立的进出口报告和分类制度，成为其他国家的榜样。但它在埃及其他地方行不通。1913年，人们尝试为国内商业复制类似制度，开展一项原打算每年进行的尼罗河内河航运调查。由于港口和船主拒绝提供足够信息，这一尝试被放弃。1928年又尝试调查这类信息，但仅取得部分成功。

en: Much more difficult was the attempt to measure the invisible part of foreign trade, the import and export of capital. A 1910 report listed the following obstacles: the “fictitious circulation” created by banks and commercial houses, which was completely unmeasurable; the impossibility of establishing the value of the credit notes created for the import and export of commodities; tourist expenses paid by checks, letters of credit, and foreign banknotes; letters of credit or checks issued to Egyptians who summered in Europe; payments for the army of occupation; profits or losses of Egyptian speculators in foreign stock exchanges; fees paid by ships in port or transiting the Suez Canal, or for the loading of coal; rent and investment income of foreigners resident in Egypt; and rents, interest, and profit on foreign capital invested in Egypt, especially in banks and joint stock companies.
Note that every one of these obstacles relates to the colonial situation of Egypt.
zh: 远为困难的是衡量对外贸易中看不见的部分，即资本的进出口。1910年的一份报告列出以下障碍：银行和商行造成的“虚假流通”，完全无法衡量；无法确定为商品进出口而创设的信用票据的价值；以支票、信用证和外国纸币支付的游客开支；发给在欧洲度夏的埃及人的信用证或支票；支付占领军的款项；埃及投机者在外国证券交易所的利润或亏损；船舶在港口或通过苏伊士运河的费用，或装载煤炭的费用；居住在埃及的外国人的租金和投资收入；以及在埃及投资的外国资本的租金、利息和利润，尤其是投资于银行和股份公司的资本。
注意，这些障碍每一项都与埃及的殖民处境有关。

en: Similar difficulties existed in establishing the movement of the population into and out of Egypt. Passports were introduced after World War I, but were used to record only arrivals, not departures. In 1922, as I mentioned, the International Labour Office in Geneva asked member states to compile national figures on population movement in order to establish currents of international migration. The Statistics Department eventually persuaded the passport office to introduce a system of passport cards that would match arrivals and departures, but the effort was derailed by the slump of 1929. The measurement of population movements was not resumed until during or after World War II.
zh: 在确定进出埃及的人口运动方面，也存在类似困难。护照制度在第一次世界大战后引入，但只用于记录入境，不记录出境。如我所述，1922年日内瓦的国际劳工局要求成员国汇编全国人口变动数字，以确定国际移民的流向。统计局最终说服护照管理部门引入一种护照卡片制度，以匹配入境与出境记录，但这一努力因1929年的经济衰退而中断。直到第二次世界大战期间或战后，人口运动的衡量才得以恢复。

en: The measurement of personal and company income was also very slow to be established, and once again the colonial situation was part of the reason. Prior to 1936, foreigners resident in Egypt were under the jurisdiction of their own governments rather than the government of Egypt. The foreign governments refused to agree to the imposition of an income tax, so income tax was not introduced until 1939.This meant that there was no requirement for individuals or companies to report annual income, or to organize their financial affairs as a yearly system of income and expenses. Even joint stock companies, which did publish annual figures, followed no uniform method of accounting, so incomes of different companies were not comparable. In the countryside, there was no systematic attempt to measure agricultural income until 1942. This effort was undertaken in response to the wartime crisis of food supply, discussed in chapter 1. But the crisis led to the introduction of crop controls and rationing and dramatic shifts in the crops grown and in prices. There was no reliable way to measure income in the midst of such disruption, so the attempt had to be abandoned.
zh: 个人和公司收入的衡量也很晚才建立，殖民处境同样是部分原因。1936年之前，居住在埃及的外国人受本国政府而非埃及政府管辖。外国政府拒绝同意征收所得税，因此直到1939年才引入所得税。这意味着，个人或公司没有被要求申报年收入，也没有被要求把财务事务组织成年度收支体系。即使是确实公布年度数字的股份公司，也没有遵循统一的会计方法，因此不同公司的收入无法比较。在乡村，直到1942年才有系统衡量农业收入的尝试。这一努力是为了应对第一章讨论的战时粮食供应危机。但危机导致作物管制、配给制以及种植作物和价格的剧烈变化。在这种混乱之中没有可靠的方法衡量收入，因此这一尝试不得不放弃。

en: These problems made it impossible to calculate in any convincing manner the country’s total “national income,” despite recent attempts to narrow the meaning of this term and transform it into a concept that could be represented statistically. In 1922 A. L. Bowley published an article in the Economic Journal in London entitled “The Definition of National Income.” He proposed that the term be defined to include only monetary income, thus excluding, for example, “the value of women’s domestic services,” or the annual value of using one’s clothes, furniture, or motorcar. Even so, he acknowledged, it would be many years before methods of calculating national income were feasible, especially given the financial distortions caused by the war.
Later that year, however, I. G. Lévi, the director of the Statistics Department, published the first attempt to estimate a national income for Egypt.

The attempt coincided with Egypt’s formal independence from Britain and had a directly political purpose: to argue that the country’s national income was much higher than the British had believed, and that it therefore possessed the resources to embark on a program of industrialization, to which Britain was opposed. (Lévi went on to become the head of the Egyptian Federation of Industries.) Yet there was no agreement on how to calculate the total. British statisticians accused Lévi of overestimating national income by 50 percent, in particular because his accounting method failed to deduct many of the expenses incurred in the production of income, especially in agriculture.
zh: 这些问题使人们无法以任何令人信服的方式计算该国的总“国民收入”，尽管近来有人尝试收窄这一术语的含义，把它转变为一个可以用统计表征的概念。1922年，A. L. 鲍利在伦敦《经济学杂志》上发表题为《国民收入的定义》的文章。他提议把该词定义为只包括货币收入，从而排除例如“妇女家务劳动的价值”，或使用自己的衣服、家具或汽车的年价值。即便如此，他承认，要过许多年才可能具备计算国民收入的方法，尤其是考虑到战争造成的财政扭曲。
然而，那年晚些时候，统计局局长I. G. 莱维发表了首次估算埃及国民收入的尝试。
这一尝试恰逢埃及正式脱离英国独立，具有直接的政治目的：论证该国国民收入远高于英国人所认为的水平，因此拥有资源启动一项英国所反对的工业化计划。（莱维后来成为埃及工业联合会的主席。）然而，关于如何计算总额并无共识。英国统计学家指责莱维高估国民收入50%，特别是因为他的会计方法未能扣除生产收入过程中的许多费用，尤其是在农业中。

en: The political rivalry in the production of economic statistics was not an isolated incident. Indeed the entire history of statistics in the early decades of the twentieth century was caught up in the struggle between Egypt and Britain, with France and other European powers often intervening against the British. The founding of the Société d’Economie Politique in 1909 was directly supported by the French government, which paid for a French political economist, Germain Martin, to spend six months in Egypt helping to organize the association and establish its journal.
The initiative was connected with the founding of the first Egyptian national university the year before, which the British attempted to block and refused to give financial support.
zh: 经济统计生产中的政治竞争并非孤立事件。事实上，20世纪最初几十年整个统计史都卷入了埃及与英国的斗争，法国和其他欧洲列强常常站在英国的对立面进行干预。1909年政治经济学学会的创立得到法国政府的直接支持，法方出资让法国政治经济学家热尔曼·马丁在埃及逗留六个月，帮助组织该学会并创办其会刊。
这一举措与一年前埃及第一所国立大学的创立有关；英国曾试图阻挠该大学，并拒绝给予财政支持。

en: Such political rivalry was an aspect of a more general set of factors affecting the growth of statistical knowledge. The European colonization of Egypt made the very economic facts that statistics wished to fix far more elusive and difficult to define. The fluid movement of capital and population, the multiplicity of languages and jurisdictions, and the legal privileges and prerogatives enjoyed by foreign communities in Egypt made it enormously difficult to represent the country as a singular, national economy. Consider the problems faced by what might seem the relatively straightforward process of counting the inhabitants of the country. The 1917 census, said to be the first reliable enumeration of the population, was carefully scheduled for the month of May, the only period when the population was thought to be in its “normal state.” It was the only month in which there were no foreign tourists, movements of agricultural laborers, summer exodus to Europe, or major popular feasts. The census still had to deal with the displacements of labor and restrictions on movement imposed by the war and the large army of occupation.

And although the census was planned to capture the entire population on a single day, in fact it took two weeks to conduct. In addition, those responsible described the following difficulties that they faced:
zh: 这种政治竞争是影响统计知识增长的一组更普遍因素的一个方面。欧洲对埃及的殖民使统计力图固定的经济事实本身更加难以捉摸和界定。资本和人口的流动不居、语言和司法管辖的多样性，以及外国侨民群体在埃及享有的法律特权和优先权，使把这个国家表征为一个单一的民族经济极为困难。试想清点该国居民这一看似相对简单的过程所面临的问题。1917年人口普查据说是有史以来第一次可靠的人口清点，它被精心安排在五月，因为这是人们认为人口处于“常态”的唯一时期。这是唯一既没有外国游客、没有农业劳动力流动、没有赴欧度夏、也没有大型民间节庆的月份。这次普查仍然必须应对战争造成的劳动力迁移和行动限制，以及庞大的占领军。
而且，尽管普查计划在一天之内涵盖全部人口，实际上却进行了两周。此外，负责者描述了以下困难：

en: 1. Illiteracy rates of 86.3 percent for men and 97.9 percent for women, making it necessary for the census agents to fill in the forms themselves—but among the Muslim population (91.4 percent), the agents were forbidden access to the home.
zh: 1. 男性文盲率86.3%，女性97.9%，普查员因此不得不自己填写表格——但在穆斯林人口（91.4%）中，普查员被禁止进入家户。

en: 2. The population’s “inveterate suspicion of all demands for information coming from the government” (despite a public campaign to convince them of its innocent purpose).
zh: 2. 民众“对政府提出的一切信息要求怀有根深蒂固的怀疑”（尽管当局开展了公共宣传，使人们相信其目的是无害的）。

en: 3. The population’s opposition to putting on paper any information relating to their economic situation, or the ages or even names of boys.
zh: 3. 民众反对把任何与其经济状况有关的信息，或男孩的年龄甚至姓名，写在纸上。

en: 4. The political situation in which “one part of the population, the natives, detests the government and the other part, the foreign colonies, consider themselves to form little states within the state and do not readily acknowledge the right of the local Administration to interfere in their affairs without the permission of their diplomatic representatives.”
zh: 4. 政治状况：一部分人口即本地人憎恶政府，而另一部分即外国侨民群体自认为在国家内部组成小国家，不经其外交代表许可，不愿承认地方行政机构有权干涉其事务。

en: 5. The absence of a definition of Egyptian nationality, with Greek, Ottoman, and Persian subjects rarely declaring their true nationality, “in order to hold open the door of declaring another nationality in case of need.”
zh: 5. 埃及国籍没有定义，希腊、奥斯曼和波斯臣民很少声明真实国籍，“以便在需要时保留声明另一种国籍的门路”。

en: 6. The considerable number of homeless people living on the streets of the cities.
zh: 6. 大量无家可归者露宿城市街头。

en: 7. Minor officials in the provinces who have the habit of not discussing orders from the central government, even to ask for an explanation to ensure a better execution, “leading to illogical actions and dangerously liberal interpretations.”
zh: 7. 各省小官员习惯于不讨论中央政府的命令，甚至不询问解释以确保更好执行，“导致不合逻辑的行动和危险地随意的解释”。

en: 8. The “absence or frequent changing of street names, formation of new villages, division of these or transfer from one administrative district to another, the absence of numbers on buildings and maps of towns.”
zh: 8. “街道名称的缺失或频繁变更，新村庄的设立，村庄的划分或从一个行政区划转到另一个行政区划，建筑物上编号和城镇地图的缺失。”

en: 9. The presence of a large nomadic population on the outskirts of certain provinces, “so unapproachable and fiercely jealous of their independence that ordinary census methods could not be applied.” 10. The multiplicity of languages spoken and the confusion of different nationalities and races, often in the same buildings and residential quarters, “so that census agents must be accomplished polyglots and full of tact to accomplish their task.” 11. The circumstances in paragraphs (4) and (10) required the use of numerous languages in both the questions and replies, demanding educated, professional decipherers. 12. The Europeans who directed the census, lacking close contact with the natives, were liable to “overlook in the Arabic versions improper expressions that may influence the results.”
zh: 9. 某些省份边缘存在大量游牧人口，“如此难以接近，又如此强烈地珍视自己的独立，以至于无法采用普通的人口普查方法”。10. 所讲语言的多样性，以及不同国籍和种族的人混杂——常常住在同一建筑和居住区——“以至于普查员必须精通多种语言且十分圆滑，才能完成任务”。11. 第（4）段和第（10）段所述情况要求问题和答复都使用多种语言，因而需要受过教育、专业的解读人员。12. 主持普查的欧洲人与本地人缺乏密切接触，容易“在阿拉伯文版本中忽略可能影响结果的不当表述”。

en: These were the disruptions and displacements that resulted from the colonial situation: the confusion of jurisdictions, languages, and races, the absence or illegibility of street names and numbers, the formation of new villages and shifting of their boundaries, and the persistent threat of improper decipherment and translation. Native officials in the provinces, operating at a distance from the European authorities in Cairo, made “dangerously liberal interpretations.” Europeans at the center, distanced from the natives, were unable to keep out the improper expressions that contaminated the Arabic texts and distorted the results.
zh: 这些就是殖民处境造成的扰乱与错位：司法管辖、语言和种族的混杂，街道名称和编号的缺失或难以辨认，新村庄的形成及其边界的变动，以及不当解读和翻译的持续威胁。各省的本地官员远离开罗的欧洲当局运作，作出“危险地随意的解释”。身处中心的欧洲人远离本地人，无法排除那些污染阿拉伯文文本、扭曲结果的不当表述。

en: Attempts to calculate the country’s national income faced a similar range of difficulties. Following I. G. Lévi’s much criticized attempt in 1922–23, the first comprehensive calculation was A Study of the National Income of Egypt, the doctoral thesis published by Mahmoud Amin Anise in 1950.The author depended for his calculations on whatever existing statistical information was available, including the population census (with all its problems) and a variety of partial surveys of various aspects of production, prices, and incomes, each relating to different years and different parts of the country. He also faced the difficulties of Egypt’s particular position in relation not to the colonial powers but what were now called other “national economies,” from which, despite the new terminology, it was not exactly separate. “One of the peculiarities of the Egyptian economy,” the author explained, “is its cosmopolitan [sic] and to a certain extent its dependence on foreign capital and technical knowledge. In answering the question whose income we are attempting to measure I was not completely satisfied.”

Industry and commerce, he pointed out, had been developed mostly by foreign capital or by foreigners resident in Egypt. He decided to define national income as income accruing to any resident of the country, whether a national or foreigner. But his income totals for the country also included profits and dividends going abroad.
zh: 计算该国国民收入的尝试面临类似的一连串困难。继1922—1923年I. G. 莱维受到诸多批评的尝试之后，第一项全面计算是马哈茂德·阿明·阿尼斯于1950年出版的博士论文《埃及国民收入研究》。作者的计算依赖一切可得的现有统计信息，包括人口普查（及其全部问题）以及关于生产、价格和收入各个方面的各种局部调查，这些调查各自涉及不同年份和该国不同地区。他还面临埃及特殊处境的困难：此时它面对的不再是殖民列强，而是现在被称为其他“国民经济”的东西；尽管有了新术语，它实际上并未与这些经济完全分离。作者解释说：“埃及经济的独特之处之一，是它的世界主义［原文如此］，以及在某种程度上对外国资本和技术知识的依赖。在回答我们试图衡量谁的收入这个问题时，我并不完全满意。”
他指出，工业和商业主要是由外国资本或居住在埃及的外国人发展起来的。他决定把国民收入定义为本国任何居民——无论国民还是外国人——获得的收入。但他为该国计算的收入总额还包括流向国外的利润和股息。

en: The problems of measuring the size of the agricultural workforce have already been mentioned, one method of estimating producing a figure between 30 and 40 percent higher than another method, with the result that measures of agricultural income were a complete guess. Industrial income was similarly difficult to estimate, in part because most establishments did not keep annual accounts. Most businesses classified as manufacturing were in fact engaged in repair work, another reflection of the colonial situation, making it impossible to calculate the proper value of raw materials and output.
zh: 衡量农业劳动力规模的问题已经提及：一种估算方法得出的数字比另一种方法高30%到40%，结果农业收入的衡量完全靠猜测。工业收入同样难以估算，部分原因是大多数企业不保存年度账目。大多数被归类为制造业的企业实际上从事修理工作，这是殖民处境的又一个反映，使人们无法计算原材料和产出的适当价值。

en: A further problem was that international organizations now demanded that statistics be measured and presented in standardized forms, so that comparison was possible from one country to the next. In practice the standard form was usually based on the social and economic arrangements found in the West.

For example, the agricultural census was to be organized as a study of “farms.” These were the units to be counted and measured and by which the animals, crops, workers, and machinery were to be enumerated. Most agricultural households in Egypt worked dispersed fragments of land that were not organized as farms, and many held machinery or animals in partnership. Large estates, on the other hand, were more than farms, as we have seen, and were operated as “private villages.” For this reason many aspects of the census were impossible to apply. Such standardization reproduced on the international level a process of homogenization and averaging that is a characteristic of statistical work in general.
zh: 另一个问题是，国际组织此时要求以标准化形式衡量和呈现统计，以便在国与国之间进行比较。在实践中，标准形式通常以西方发现的社会和经济安排为基础。
例如，农业普查被组织为对“农场”的研究。农场是要清点和衡量的单位，牲畜、作物、工人和机械都要按农场来计数。埃及大多数农业家庭耕种的是分散的、未组织为农场的零碎土地，许多家庭还合伙持有机械或牲畜。另一方面，如我们所见，大型地产不止是农场，而是作为“私人村庄”运营。因此，普查的许多方面无法适用。这种标准化在国际层面复制了一个同质化和取平均的过程，而这是统计工作的一般特征。

en: Although colonialism provided an impetus and field for the development of statistical and economic knowledge, the stabilization of this knowledge as the “national economy” would not be possible until the era of the nation-state—and indeed would be part of the constitution of that transient era. By mid-century, in Egypt as in many other places, politics had acquired a new object. The economy had come into being as a sphere that could be measured, managed, developed, analyzed, restructured, and compared. I have traced some of the practices that helped form the economy, involving a range of processes from mapping and statistics to property, law, agricultural transformation, and colonial power. The mixture and form of these processes would vary, of course, in other places, but the details of what happened in Egypt can enable us to look more closely at what occurred. I have also traced the “reading difficulties” that arose. There are four things we can learn from these events about the making of the economy.
zh: 尽管殖民主义为统计知识和经济知识的发展提供了动力和场域，但这种知识作为“国民经济”的稳定化，直到民族国家时代才成为可能——而且实际上将是那个短暂时代的构成的一部分。到世纪中叶，在埃及和许多其他地方一样，政治获得了一个新对象。经济已经形成，成为一个可以衡量、管理、发展、分析、重组和比较的领域。我已追溯了一些帮助形成经济的实践，涉及从测绘和统计到产权、法律、农业转型和殖民权力的一系列过程。这些过程的组合和形式在其他地方当然会有所不同，但埃及发生的事情的具体细节，能使我们更仔细地审视所发生之事。我还追溯了由此产生的“阅读困难”。从这些事件中，我们可以就经济的制造学到四点。

en: First, although economic and statistical practice will claim, like Lyons, to map this sphere with great precision, we should notice what those involved actually do. They are often very careful and precise, and they always stress the accuracy of their work. But we should not be misled by their claims into thinking that the novelty and usefulness of this knowledge lay in its accuracy. Once more the cadastral survey can illuminate the point. As we saw, the attraction of the use of mapping was that from now on information about landholding would be contained on the map. To calculate the area of a holding it was no longer necessary to measure with rods or chains on the ground. Thanks to the accuracy of the map, one could read the measurement from the surface of the map. The site of control and calculation had been transplanted from the field to the office.
zh: 首先，尽管经济实践和统计实践会像莱昂斯那样，声称以极高的精度测绘这个领域，我们仍应注意参与者实际做了什么。他们往往非常仔细和精确，而且总是强调其工作的准确性。但我们不应被他们的宣称误导，以为这种知识的新颖与有用之处在于其准确性。地籍测量可以再次说明这一点。如我们所见，使用测绘的吸引力在于，从此关于土地持有的信息将包含在地图上。要计算一处土地持有的面积，不再需要在实地用测杆或测链丈量。由于地图的精确性，人们可以从地图表面读出测量结果。控制和计算的场所从现场移植到了办公室。

en: Yet this calculation from the map was very difficult. There was a problem of shrinkage, as the moisture in the map paper dried out. Even after drying the paper for three weeks prior to drawing the map, the surveyors had to include a calculation for shrinkage of the paper when calculating the area of an individual plot from the map.

But the larger problem was how to calculate this area in the first place. No plot was perfectly regular, so measuring the sides alone from the map would not work. To solve the difficulty, the surveyors introduced a device developed by the Revenue Survey of India, which they called the feddan comb. This consisted of a small frame made of stiff cardboard, 21 × 17 centimeters (about the size of this page), with dots printed through the card at 5 millimeter intervals along the long sides through which fine black threads ran in parallel lines from side to side, dividing the area within the frame into strips 5 millimeters in width. When placed over the map, the threads divided a plot into strips whose breadth corresponded to 12.5 meters on the ground. The surveyor used a pair of dividers to measure the length of each strip, stepping out the dividers to read off each measurement against a translation scale printed on the border of the card. The sum of these measurements gave the area of a plot.

The method was ingenious but far from accurate. “The weak point about the feddan comb,” Lyons acknowledged, “is that it is almost impossible to keep the threads tight and parallel. Further, to thread them through the exact positions is difficult and the dots are not always placed at the correct distance apart, which may be due to shrinkage of the cardboard after printing.”

The shrinkage of the cardboard, the shrinkage of the map paper, the inaccurate placing of the dots, and the difficulty in holding the threads tight and parallel meant that it would not, after all, be possible to measure landholdings and determine tax liabilities directly from the map.
zh: 然而，从地图上进行这种计算非常困难。存在纸张收缩的问题，因为地图纸张中的水分会蒸发。即使在地图绘制前把纸张干燥三周，测量员从地图计算单个地块面积时，仍必须把纸张收缩计算在内。

但更大的问题首先是，如何计算这个面积。没有一块地是完全规则的，因此仅从地图上测量各边行不通。为解决这一困难，测量员引入一种由印度田赋测量局开发的装置，他们称之为“费丹梳”。它由一个硬纸板制成的小框架组成，尺寸为21×17厘米（约与本章页面相当）；沿长边每隔5毫米在纸板上印有孔点，细黑线从一侧到另一侧穿过这些孔点，平行排列，把框架内的面积分成宽5毫米的长条。把框架放在地图上时，这些线把地块分成若干长条，其宽度在地面上相当于12.5米。测量员用一副分规量出每个长条的长度，用分规一步步量，并对照印在纸板边缘的换算尺读出每次测量值。这些测量值之和得出地块的面积。
这种方法很巧妙，却远不精确。莱昂斯承认：“费丹梳的弱点在于，几乎不可能让细线保持绷紧和平行。此外，要把线穿过准确的位置也很困难，孔点之间的距离并不总是正确，这可能是印刷后纸板收缩造成的。”
纸板收缩、地图纸张收缩、孔点位置不准，以及难以让细线保持绷紧和平行，意味着终究不可能直接根据地图丈量土地持有并确定纳税义务。

en: The cardboard frame illuminates an important aspect of the making of expertise in the twentieth century. The new statistical methods did not generate a more accurate knowledge, or even a greater amount of knowledge. Captain Lyons was forced to admit that after ten years of work, the survey had produced a knowledge of the area of each landholding that was less precise than before. Although he criticized the old Coptic rules of arithmetic—while admitting the rules were accurate enough when plots were not too far out of square, and in fact most plots were relatively square—his own methods resulted in a less reliable calculation. What the survey accomplished was a series of removals, of transferences, that tried to shift the site where calculation would occur. In place of the village surveyor walking with his rod along the boundaries of each plot, the employee in the survey office would walk his dividers across the feddan comb, stepping them backwards and forwards from the threads to the scale.
zh: 这个纸板框架揭示了20世纪专门知识制造的一个重要方面。新的统计方法并未产生更准确的知识，甚至没有产生更多知识。莱昂斯上尉被迫承认，经过十年工作，这次测量产生的关于每处土地持有面积的知识，不如以前精确。尽管他批评旧的科普特算术规则——同时承认当地块不太偏离方形时，这些规则足够准确，而事实上大多数地块相对方正——他自己的方法却产生了更不可靠的计算。这次测量所完成的，是一连串抽离和转移，试图把计算发生的场所挪走。代替村庄测量员手持测杆沿每块地的边界行走的，是测量局雇员在费丹梳上移动分规，从细线到刻度尺来回丈量。

en: The problem of accuracy was not specific to the survey or the difficulties of drawing maps. Similar difficulties arose with other forms of knowledge. The new statistics on the price of cotton, for example, represented an approximation. The farmer may well have had a more accurate knowledge of the cotton price. He knew it from day to day, in his locality, for the variety of seed he grew, among the particular merchants with whom he had to deal. The figures collected in the statistical yearbook, or even the weekly prices published by the Ministry of Agriculture, were not the price of any particular cotton, or of all the different cottons at all the different places cotton was sold. Likewise, as we just saw, the agricultural census organized information in terms of “farms,” a simplification that could never accommodate the forms of knowledge and relationship that constituted the world of the countryside. Here, too, one might say, there were shrinkage problems. Once again, the statistical knowledge cannot be said to be a more accurate knowledge, or even a greater amount of knowledge. Instead, it represents a reformatted knowledge, information that has been translated, moved, shrunk, simplified, redrawn. What is new is the site, and the forms of calculation and decision that can take place at this new site.
zh: 准确性问题并非测量或绘图困难所特有。其他形式的知识也出现了类似困难。例如，关于棉花价格的新统计只是一种近似。农民很可能对棉花价格有更准确的认识。他逐日了解当地的价格，了解自己所种植种子品种的价格，了解自己必须打交道的那些特定商人给出的价格。统计年鉴收集的数字，甚至农业部公布的每周价格，都不是某种特定棉花的价格，也不是所有不同地点出售的所有不同棉花的价格。同样，如我们刚刚所见，农业普查按“农场”组织信息，这种简化永远无法容纳构成乡村世界的知识形式和关系形式。这里也可以说存在收缩问题。再一次，这种统计知识不能说是更准确的知识，甚至不能说是更多的知识。相反，它代表一种重新格式化的知识，一种经过翻译、移动、收缩、简化、重新绘制的信息。新的东西是场所，以及在这个新场所能够进行的计算和决策形式。

en: The second point follows from this act of removal: the new forms of economic and statistical knowledge did not stand in relation to the economy in the simple relation of a representation to reality, the way a map is thought to represent the real world. And yet this is how it would appear. The removal and concentration of knowledge into new sites opened up a distance, a gap that came to seem an absolute divide. The movement from the field to the survey office was not to be experienced as a chain of social practices, but as the distance between reality and its representation, between the material and the abstract, between the real world and the map.
zh: 第二点由这一抽离行为得出：新的经济知识和统计知识，并不以表征与实在的简单关系面对经济，不像地图被认为表征真实世界那样。然而它看起来恰恰如此。知识被抽离并集中到新场所，打开了一段距离，一道后来显得像绝对鸿沟的裂隙。从现场到测量办公室的移动，不再被经验为一连串社会实践，而被经验为现实与其表征之间、物质与抽象之间、真实世界与地图之间的距离。

en: This is a point we have encountered in different ways already, in discussions of the making of the Aswan Dam, for example, of the concentration of property claims into the rules of law, or Simmel’s experience of the metropolis as a world of objectified culture. Both the old system of surveying and the new involved a variety of social practices, every one of which might be thought of as a mixture of action and thought, measurement and calculation, object and idea, thing and value, reality and representation. The village surveyor might read off distances with his rod and chain, clean off a boundary mark with his foot, write down measurements in his register, argue with the owner of the next plot, and report alterations to the tax office. All these processes involved mixtures of what are called real and representation, thing and value, or object and idea. In fact it would be impossible to hold them apart according to such a distinction. In the same way the mapmaker, holding the feddan comb in one hand, trying to keep the cardboard flat and its threads taut, walking the pair of dividers with the other hand, making sure its point does not slip as he reads the measurement off the scale, cursing the heat that has shrunk his paper, and trying to prevent the whole sheet lifting into the air under the ceiling fans whirling above his head, is involved in as much a practical activity as a mental one, dealing with an object as much as a representation. Saussure, the famous theorist of linguistic representation, describes the difference between an idea or representation and the material that represents it as no more than the difference between two sides of the same sheet of paper. For the mapmaker the difference is even less, and that is exactly the source of his difficulty. The dimensions of the paper are a representation, the signifier of a certain distance on the ground. But the size of the paper, the distance from one pen mark to another, is also a distance “on the ground,” or at least on the table, a real distance, and one that will not stay still. He cannot keep reality out of his representation.
zh: 我们已经以不同方式遇到这一点，例如在关于阿斯旺大坝的制造、财产主张向法律规则的集中，或齐美尔把大都市经验为一个客体化文化世界的讨论中。旧测量制度和新测量制度都涉及多种社会实践，每一项实践都可以被视为行动与思想、测量与计算、对象与观念、物与价值、现实与表征的混合。村庄测量员可能用测杆和测链读出距离，用脚擦掉一个边界标记，把测量结果记入登记册，与相邻地块的所有者争论，并把变更报告给税务所。所有这些过程都涉及所谓实在与表征、物与价值、或对象与观念的混合。事实上，不可能按照这种区分把它们分开。同样，地图制作者一手拿着费丹梳，努力使纸板平展、细线绷紧，另一手移动分规，在从刻度尺读取测量值时确保针尖不滑动，咒骂让纸张收缩的炎热，并设法防止整张纸在头顶旋转的吊扇下飘起；他既参与实践活动，也参与脑力活动，既在处理一个对象，也在处理一种表征。著名的语言表征理论家索绪尔，把观念或表征与表现它的物质材料之间的差异，描述为同一张纸两面的差异，仅此而已。对地图制作者来说，这种差异还要小，而这正是他困难的根源。纸张的尺寸是一种表征，是地面上某段距离的能指。但纸张的大小、从一处笔痕到另一处笔痕的距离，也是一种“地面上”的距离，或者至少是桌面上的距离，一种真实的距离，而且是一种不会保持静止的距离。他无法把现实排除在表征之外。

en: Our world is made up of technical bodies, hybrids that are neither wholly objects nor ideas, more than just things but not disembodied spirits (hence appearing as crystallized spirit), not properly divisible into nature and culture, or reality and representation. The clerks in the survey office converted theodolite and chain readings from the field into distances to be drawn on the map. Their computational labor was divided up and correlated to form “an almost mechanical system,” something close to a piece of machinery. A calculating apparatus, made out of men, had the mechanical powers of a computer. Like all computers, it was a mixture of hardware and software. But at the same time, the new world of modern politics is organized to manufacture the effect that this difficult, unstable, temporary distinction between hard and soft, physical and mental, real and representational, is a permanent, fundamental, and ontological divide. The map presents itself as a mere representation, an idea or abstraction, set apart from the real, fixed, physical reality it depicts. It erases and hides the contested, political, representational nature of the world it portrays, in the same action with which it denies its own (shrinking) physicality. The mechanical organization of labor, the movement from the field to the office, the repeated accounts of the precision and accuracy of the work, all operate together to produce the effect of a bifurcated world. It is as such an effect that the economy is brought into being.
zh: 我们的世界由技术身体构成，这些混合体既不是完全的对象，也不完全是观念，不只是物，但也不是无形体的精神（因此显现为结晶化的精神），不能恰当地被分为自然与文化、或现实与表征。测量局的职员把野外的经纬仪和测链读数换算成要绘制在地图上的距离。他们的计算劳动被划分并相互关联，构成“一套近乎机械的系统”，某种接近机械装置的东西。一台由人构成的计算装置，拥有计算机的机械能力。像所有计算机一样，它是硬件和软件的混合。但同时，现代政治的新世界被组织起来，以制造这样一种效果：硬与软、身体与心智、实在与表征之间这种困难、不稳定、暂时的区分，是一种永恒、根本、本体论上的鸿沟。地图把自己呈现为一种纯粹的表征，一种观念或抽象，与它所描绘的真实、固定、物理的现实相分离。它抹去并隐藏了它所描绘世界的充满争议的、政治的、表征的性质，这一动作同时否认了它自身（会收缩的）物质性。劳动的机械化组织、从现场到办公室的移动、对工作精密与准确的反复宣称，共同作用，产生一个二分世界的效果。经济正是作为这样一种效果而被带入存在的。

en: Third, it is these processes of organization, movement, reformulation, and exclusion that set up the economy as a new sphere of calculability. The making of the economy, it follows, does not lie outside the forms of knowledge that enable statistics and economics to know it.

Another example— the introduction of price barometers—can illustrate this. In July 1910, I. G. Lévi and Germain Martin pointed out that “while for the theoreticians of economic equilibrium a market consists of the fixity of prices, at a given moment, for a quantity of products of the same type and of the same quality, in Egypt prices vary in relation to certain commodities from place to place, beyond the costs of movement and transportation, especially in the villages.” The price variation can be found, they pointed out, even between villages only a few kilometers apart. To remedy the anomaly, they proposed the publication of price barometers in all the villages of Egypt, listing the current prices of commodities in nearby towns.

This simple proposal illustrates the method of constituting the economy. It is repeated in the work of the surveyors. They found rural property relations contested, the subject of multiple claims, agrarian transformations, and violent histories. Their response was not to record these multiple claims and histories of violence on the map, but to help format the world they surveyed, dividing it into fields and plots, determining ownership, naming estates as villages, marking boundaries, and rejecting appeals for adjustment. Lévi and Martin found forms of social practice that did not correspond to the abstract theories of the market. Their answer was not to alter the theory, to take more accurate account of what happens, but to propose an alteration to what happens, to bring it closer to the simpler practice of theory. Expert knowledge works to format social relations, never simply to report or picture them.
zh: 第三，正是这些组织、移动、重新表述和排除的过程，把经济建立为一个新的可计算性领域。由此可知，经济的制造并不位于使统计学和经济学得以认识它的知识形式之外。

另一个例子——价格晴雨表的引入——可以说明这一点。1910年7月，I. G. 莱维和热尔曼·马丁指出：“对于经济均衡的理论家来说，一个市场意味着在给定时刻，一定数量同类同质产品的价格是固定一致的；但在埃及，某些商品的价格因地而异，其差异超出运输和搬运成本，在村庄尤其如此。”他们指出，甚至仅相隔几公里的村庄之间也能发现价格差异。为纠正这一异常，他们提议在埃及所有村庄公布价格晴雨表，列出附近城镇的当前商品价格。

这个简单的提议说明了构成经济的方法。它在测量员的工作中重演。他们发现乡村财产关系充满争议，是多重主张、农业变迁和暴力历史的主题。他们的应对不是在图上记录这些多重主张和暴力历史，而是帮助格式化他们所测量的世界：把它划分为田和地块，确定所有权，把地产命名为村庄，标出边界，并驳回调整的申诉。莱维和马丁发现了一些与抽象市场理论不符的社会实践形式。他们的回答不是改变理论、更准确地考虑实际发生的事情，而是提议改变实际发生的事情，使它更接近理论那种更简单的做法。专门知识致力于格式化社会关系，绝非单纯报告或描绘它们。

en: The economic historian Karl Polanyi is remembered for his argument that the modern world was formed in the “Great Transformation” of the nineteenth century, in which market relations became disembedded from the wider social ties in which they were previously contained.

The separation of economic ties from other forms of social practice that had previously governed and limited them, he argued, gave rise to the self-regulating market economy (which quickly proved itself incapable of its own regulation). The Great Transformation, published in 1944, was one of the most influential works to depict the construction of “the economy” as a separate sphere in the nineteenth century. It can be reread today, however, not just as an account of nineteenth-century European history, but on another level as one more contribution to the twentieth-century production of the economy. The event that Polanyi projects back onto the nineteenth century, the emergence of the economy as a separate sphere, was in fact realized only in the mid-twentieth century. And theoretical essays such as Polanyi’s wartime writing were part of this work of production. The economy came into being not by disembedding market relations from a larger social ground that previously contained them, but by embedding certain twentieth-century practices of calculation, description, and enumeration in new forms of intellectual, calculating, regulatory, and governmental practice. The economy, in Callon’s phrase, is embedded in economics, and in social theory, in colonial administration, in national income accounting, and in all the other practical activities of mid-twentieth-century social life that formatted, shaped, and made the new field of national politics.
zh: 经济史学家卡尔·波兰尼因其论证而为人铭记：现代世界形成于19世纪的“大转型”，市场关系从先前包含它们的更广泛社会纽带中脱嵌。

他论证说，经济纽带与先前支配和限制它们的其他社会实践形式相分离，产生了自我调节的市场经济（它很快证明自身无法自我调节）。1944年出版的《大转型》是最有影响的著作之一，把“经济”描述为19世纪一个独立领域的建构。然而，今天重读此书，不仅可以把它看作对19世纪欧洲历史的叙述，还可以在另一层面上把它看作对20世纪经济生产的又一贡献。波兰尼投射回19世纪的那个事件——经济作为一个独立领域的出现——实际上直到20世纪中叶才实现。而波兰尼的战时写作等理论文章，是这一生产工作的一部分。经济的形成，不是通过把市场关系从先前包含它们的更大社会基础中脱嵌，而是通过把20世纪某些计算、描述和列举的实践嵌入知识、计算、规制和治理实践的新形式之中。用卡隆的话说，经济被嵌入经济学，嵌入社会理论、殖民行政、国民收入核算，以及20世纪中叶社会生活中所有其他格式化了、塑造了并造就了国家政治这一新领域的实践活动。

en: Finally, it should be recalled, this attempt at formatting, at relocating the site where calculations occur in the uniform space of a national economy, was not successful. As we have seen, the forms of social practice that gave rise to the new kinds of calculability, and that calculation attempted to format, also continually rendered the world more mobile, uncertain, and incalculable. The surveyors’ map presented itself as a picture of a reality on the ground. But that reality “on the ground” did not stay out there, it entered into the making of the map—not only in the problems of shrinkage, but in everything from the moving of survey marks and the disputing of boundaries to the entire politics of rural property claims that were involved in the act of survey. The experts themselves tried to limit this disruption, to frame and define the world that they hoped to measure and survey. But in the very act of framing, they were continually exposed to the difficulties of drawing limits, of successfully transferring political conflicts to the narrow sites of calculation they had mastered.
zh: 最后应当回想，这种格式化尝试——把计算发生的场所迁移到国民经济的均质空间之中——并未成功。如我们所见，产生新型可计算性、并被计算试图格式化的社会实践形式，也不断使世界更加流动、不确定和不可计算。测量员的地图把自己呈现为对地面现实的一幅图像。但那种“在地面上”的现实并没有留在外面，它进入了地图的制造——不仅进入收缩问题，而且进入从移动测量标志、边界争议，到测量行为所涉及的全部乡村财产主张政治的一切环节。专家们自己试图限制这种扰乱，去框定和界定他们希望测量和调查的世界。但恰恰在框定的行动中，他们不断暴露于划定界限的困难，以及成功地把政治冲突转移到他们所能掌握的狭窄计算场所的困难。

en: Following the completion of the cadastral survey of Egypt in 1907, Henry Lyons returned to England and to a career as director of the Science Museum in London (previously obscure and ill arranged, it is said, but transformed by Lyons into one of the great technical museums of the world).

His successor as director-general of the Survey Department, Ernest Dowson, remained a professional surveyor in the colonial service. He accompanied the British army as it occupied Palestine and Iraq in World War I. In this capacity he helped to spread the new survey expertise developed in Egypt across the Near East, and later to sub-Saharan Africa. In 1945 he published an article criticizing the “divorce” that had developed between the practical and technical aspects of surveying on the one hand and the legal and political on the other. Surveyors needed not just technical expertise but “knowledge of the social structure, agricultural practices and land tenures, customary as well as statutory, of the community concerned,” the article claimed. “For it is only in the light of these conditions and of the juridical, fiscal, economic or other objectives sought, that they can adjust the technical to the other interlocking requirements effectively.”

These “interlocking requirements” illuminate the impossible character of calculation. Any attempt to set the limits of the technical operations of calculation must first establish and understand those limits. This opens the problem of calculation to an interminable difficulty, the need to know all those other social, agricultural, and legal practices out of which the object to be mapped is constituted.
zh: 1907年埃及地籍测量完成后，亨利·莱昂斯返回英国，出任伦敦科学博物馆馆长（据说该馆此前默默无闻、布置混乱，经莱昂斯改造后成为世界伟大的技术博物馆之一）。

接替他担任测量总局局长的欧内斯特·道森，仍是殖民部门的一名职业测量师。第一次世界大战中，他随英军占领巴勒斯坦和伊拉克。以此身份，他帮助把在埃及发展出的新测量专门知识传播到近东，后来又传播到撒哈拉以南非洲。1945年，他发表文章，批评测量工作的实践与技术方面同法律与政治方面之间形成的“分离”。文章称，测量员不仅需要技术专门知识，还需要“关于相关社区的社会结构、农业实践和土地占有制度（包括习惯法和成文法）的知识”。“因为只有根据这些条件，以及所寻求的司法、财政、经济或其他目标，他们才能有效地使技术适应其他相互关联的要求。”
这些“相互关联的要求”揭示了计算的不可能性特质。任何试图设定计算的技术操作界限的努力，都必须首先确立并理解这些界限。这使计算问题陷入一种无休止的困难：必须了解构成测绘对象的其他一切社会、农业和法律实践。

en: For an illuminating essay on List and his influence outside Europe, see Manu Goswami, “From Swadeshi to Swaraj: Nation, Economy, Territory in Colonial South Asia, 1870–1907,” Comparative Studies in Society and History 40, no. 4 (1998): 609–36. I would qualify Goswami’s argument by noting that List is using the word “economy” in the sense of government, or the proper management of wealth, not in its twentieth-century sense. Thus “national economy,” which List uses interchangeably with “people’s economy” and in contrast to “finance economy” (and without the definite article), is not an object or sphere to be managed but the process of governing a territory and its resources in the interests of its people, the nation. Friedrich List, Das nationale System der politischen Oekonomie (Stuttgart: Cotta, 1841), English translation, National System of Political Economy, trans. Sampson S. Lloyd (London: Longmans, Green, 1885; reprint ed. Fairfield, N.J.: A. M. Kelley, 1977).
zh: 关于李斯特及其在欧洲之外影响的一篇富有启发性的文章，见 Manu Goswami, “From Swadeshi to Swaraj: Nation, Economy, Territory in Colonial South Asia, 1870–1907,” Comparative Studies in Society and History 40, no. 4 (1998): 609–36. 我想对戈斯瓦米的论证作一点限定：李斯特使用“economy”一词时，取的是政府或对财富的妥善管理之意，而非其20世纪含义。因此，“国民经济”（national economy）——李斯特把它与“人民经济”（people's economy）互换使用，并与“财政经济”（finance economy）相对，且不带定冠词——不是一个有待管理的对象或领域，而是为国民的利益治理一片领土及其资源的过程。Friedrich List, Das nationale System der politischen Oekonomie (Stuttgart: Cotta, 1841), English translation, National System of Political Economy, trans. en: It is worth adding here that, as privately owned villages, the hamlets on the new estates were usually run as part of the business enterprise of the estate. There was typically a supervisor (nazir), accountant (katib), and labor supplier (khuli) running a meticulous system of management based on bookkeeping (Malak D. Rouchdy, “Change and Continuity in the Village of Batra: Family Strategies,” in Directions of Change in Rural Egypt, ed. Nicholas S. Hopkins and Kirsten Westergaard [Cairo: American University in Cairo Press, 1998], 237–55, at 245.) So besides fixing and mapping the countryside, the new system of private estates organized rural life as a system of “income” and “expenditures” and represented it in this way in its books. The much larger khedival estates were managed by the European bankers to whom they were mortgaged using similar methods. Thus in much of the countryside the daily life of the village was run according to principles of annual accounting and management that were soon to provide a new way of organizing the political process of the country as a whole.
zh: 值得补充的是，作为私人拥有的村庄，新地产上的小村落通常作为地产企业经营的一部分来管理。通常有一名监督（nazir）、会计（katib）和劳工招募者（khuli），依据簿记运行一套细致的管理制度（Malak D. Rouchdy, “Change and Continuity in the Village of Batra: Family Strategies,” in Directions of Change in Rural Egypt, ed. Nicholas S. Hopkins and Kirsten Westergaard [Cairo: American University in Cairo Press, 1998], 237–55, at 245）。因此，除了固定并测绘乡村之外，新的私人地产制度还把乡村生活组织为“收入”和“支出”体系，并以这种方式在账簿中表征它。大得多的总督领地则由受抵押的欧洲银行家以类似方式管理。因此，在乡村的许多地方，村庄的日常生活按照年度会计和管理原则运行，而这些原则不久将为把整个国家的政治过程组织起来提供一种新方式。
